title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
title_zh: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception

paragraphs.en: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model’s training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model’s true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed fibs , to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的事件凸显了监控大型语言模型智能体的挑战，以及模型欺骗人类的危险。 我们证明，通过探针进行白盒欺骗检测可以扩展至前沿监控场景：为此，我们收集了迄今为止最大的欺骗数据集用于训练探针，并引入了一种新颖的探针架构，该架构能够聚合多层级和多词元的信息。 我们的探针在 SHADE-Arena 中实现了 98.8% 的 AUC，超越了 Opus 5.5 文本监控基线模型，并且随着底层模型的规模扩大，其效果进一步提升。 为了将我们的探针推向极限，我们在多个仅凭上下文无法判断是否存在欺骗的案例中对其进行了测试。 在这些我们称为“内省性欺骗”的案例中，只有通过细致的引导询问或对模型训练数据的全面了解，才能确定真实情况。 在其中一项评估中，我们证明，探针能够以高达 99.7% 的 AUC 区分出包含模型真实隐藏目标的对话记录与其他目标。 我们的探针还能轻松检测知名开放权重模型在政治敏感话题上的欺骗行为，以及它们在受到压力时对其自身信念的虚假陈述。 我们发布了名为 fibs 的训练数据集，以推动高效探针的前沿部署，并鼓励社区通过添加更多欺骗与破坏行为的示例来扩展该数据集。

paragraphs.en: In recent months, AI agents running autonomously in training, evaluation or deployment have precipitated multiple high-profile incidents of misaligned behavior: escaping their sandboxes, hacking companies and governments, and attempting to mislead humans ( Larcher et al., 2026 , UK AI Security Institute, 2026 , Cable et al., 2026 ) , all while seemingly aware that these actions would, once subject to scrutiny, be considered undesirable by their human overseers. It is clearer than ever that careful monitoring of AI agents is critical, and that detecting knowingly deceptive actions is a clear target for effective monitoring. State-of-the-art monitoring approaches are black-box, relying on text classifiers ( Sharma et al., 2025 ) , reviewing both actions and chain-of-thought ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , and using reasoning ( Sinha et al., 2026 ) . We cannot be sure why black-box monitors were not already applied on these generations of agents, but cost is a likely factor as running powerful monitors is a substantial compute burden. Black-box monitoring is also heavily reliant on interpretable and faithful Chain-of-Thought (CoT), which is fragile ( Korbak et al., 2025 ) . There have been numerous incidents of frontier model training accidentally putting pressure on the CoT ( Carroll et al., 2026 , Anthropic, 2026 ) , and models have increasing capability without it ( Gould et al., 2026 ) . Fortunately, white-box methods have shown great promise as a vastly cheaper and versatile alternative, but demonstrating competitiveness in loss-of-control settings has remained an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: 近几个月来，在训练、评估或部署环境中自主运行的智能体引发了多起引人关注的不当行为事件：它们逃离了沙盒环境，入侵公司和政府系统，并试图误导人类（Larcher 等人，2026；英国人工智能安全研究所，2026；Cable 等人，2026）。与此同时，这些智能体似乎清楚地意识到，一旦其行为受到审查，其人类监管者就会认为这些行为是不可接受的。 如今比以往任何时候都更明确的是，对智能体的审慎监控至关重要，而检测其蓄意欺骗行为正是有效监控的一个明确目标。 当前最先进的监控方法属于黑盒方法，依赖文本分类器（Sharma 等人，2025）、对行为和思维链的审查（OpenAI，2026），以及推理能力的运用（Sinha 等人，2026）。 我们尚不确定为何这些代次的智能体尚未采用黑盒监控方法，但成本很可能是一个因素，因为运行强大的监控系统会带来巨大的计算负担。 黑盒监控还严重依赖可解释且忠实的思维链（CoT），而思维链本身却十分脆弱（Korbak 等人，2025）。 已有大量事件表明，前沿模型的训练意外地对思维链造成了压力（Carroll 等人，2026；Anthropic，2026），而模型即便没有思维链，其能力也在不断增强（Gould 等人，2026）。 幸运的是，白盒方法已展现出巨大潜力，成为成本更低且用途更广泛的替代方案，但在失控场景下证明其竞争力仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we examine the extent to which white box probes can be made competitive with black-box methods, simply by creating a large, diverse dataset and training expressive probes on the activations of modern large open-weight models. To rigorously determine ground-truth labels for our probes, we avoid the philosophical uncertainty around “deception”, which typically incorporates an agent’s intent ( Mahon, 2016 ) . Instead, we restrict ourselves to training white-box probes that detect knowing falsehoods : model statements that the model believes are false. Further, since establishing belief can require extensive elicitation, our training datasets consist of contextual falsehoods , where a model makes a statement contradicting a fact established previously in the context. The complement of contextual falsehoods are introspective falsehoods , which depend on additional knowledge about a model. For instance, if a transcript consists of a model denying having a hidden goal, deciding if the denial is a falsehood requires knowing if the model believes it has that goal.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过创建一个大型且多样化的数据集，并在现代大型开放权重模型的激活值上训练具有表现力的探针，来探究白盒探针在何种程度上可以与黑盒方法相媲美。 为了严格确定我们探针的基准标签，我们避免了围绕“欺骗”这一概念所存在的哲学不确定性，因为“欺骗”通常涉及智能体的意图（Mahon, 2016）。 相反，我们将研究范围限制在训练能够检测“认知性虚假陈述”的白盒探针上，即模型自身认为为假的陈述。 此外，由于确定信念可能需要大量的信息提取，我们的训练数据集由“语境性虚假陈述”组成，即模型在上下文中做出与先前已确立的事实相矛盾的陈述。 “语境性虚假陈述”的补集是“内省性虚假陈述”，这类陈述则依赖于对模型本身的额外知识。 例如，如果一段对话记录中模型否认自己拥有某个隐藏目标，那么要判断这一否认是否为虚假陈述，就需要知道该模型是否认为自己确实拥有这个目标。

sents.zh: 例如，如果一段对话记录中模型否认自己拥有某个隐藏目标，那么要判断这一否认是否为虚假陈述，就需要知道该模型是否认为自己确实拥有这个目标。

paragraphs.en: Within this framing, we ask: (RQ1) to what point does scaling probe training data continue to improve out-of-distribution performance; (RQ2) do probes trained on off-policy, contextual falsehoods generalize to realistic multi-turn on-policy deployments, and compete with black-box monitors there; and (RQ3) do such probes generalize to introspective falsehoods? Our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 在此框架下，我们提出以下问题：(RQ1) 扩大探针训练数据的规模在多大程度上能持续提升分布外性能；(RQ2) 在离策略、语境性虚假信息上训练的探针，能否泛化到真实的、多轮次的在策略部署环境中，并在其中与黑盒监测器相媲美；以及 (RQ3) 这类探针能否泛化到内省性虚假信息？ 我们的贡献有三方面：

sents.en: Within this framing, we ask: (RQ1) to what point does scaling probe training data continue to improve out-of-distribution performance; (RQ2) do probes trained on off-policy, contextual falsehoods generalize to realistic multi-turn on-policy deployments, and compete with black-box monitors there; and (RQ3) do such probes generalize to introspective falsehoods?
sents.zh: 在此框架下，我们提出以下问题：(RQ1) 扩大探针训练数据的规模在多大程度上能持续提升分布外性能；(RQ2) 在离策略、语境性虚假信息上训练的探针，能否泛化到真实的、多轮次的在策略部署环境中，并在其中与黑盒监测器相媲美；以及 (RQ3) 这类探针能否泛化到内省性虚假信息？

sents.en: Our contributions are threefold:
sents.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：

paragraphs.en: We release Falsehoods in Broad Settings ( fibs ), a deception dataset formed from both existing and new datasets, and spanning multiple deception types, elicitation methods, and interaction formats, from curated conversations to agentic rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了“广泛场景下的虚假陈述”（fibs）数据集，该数据集由现有和新的数据集共同构建，涵盖了多种欺骗类型、诱导方法以及互动形式，内容从精心挑选的对话到智能体自主执行的任务均有涉及。

paragraphs.en: RQ1 & RQ2: We show that scaling the amount and diversity of training data , and the capacity of white-box falsehood detectors, improves performance on monitoring long, multi-step, on-policy SHADE-Arena ( Kutasov et al., 2025 ) trajectories, where probes outperform black-box monitors that are orders of magnitude more expensive to evaluate (Figure 1(a) ).
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1与研究问题2：我们证明了，扩大训练数据的规模和多样性，以及提升白盒虚假检测器的容量，能够提高对长序列、多步骤、在线策略的 SHADE-Arena（Kutasov 等人，2025）轨迹的监控性能。在此类任务中，探测方法的表现优于评估成本高出几个数量级的黑盒监控器（图1(a)）。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Through the use of belief elicitation and model organisms, we show that probes trained primarily on contextual falsehoods detect introspective falsehoods . These falsehoods are impossible to detect from a model’s visible outputs alone, since identical answers can be a lie for one model and honest for another (Figure 1(b) ).
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：通过信念提取和模型生物体的运用，我们证明了主要基于语境性虚假信息进行训练的智能体探测器能够识别内省性虚假信息。 仅凭模型可见的输出结果无法检测出这些虚假信息，因为相同的回答对某个模型而言可能是谎言，而对另一个模型而言却是诚实的（图1(b)）。

sents.en: RQ3: Through the use of belief elicitation and model organisms, we show that probes trained primarily on contextual falsehoods detect introspective falsehoods .
sents.zh: RQ3：通过信念提取和模型生物体的运用，我们证明了主要基于语境性虚假信息进行训练的智能体探测器能够识别内省性虚假信息。

sents.en: These falsehoods are impossible to detect from a model’s visible outputs alone, since identical answers can be a lie for one model and honest for another (Figure 1(b) ).
sents.zh: 仅凭模型可见的输出结果无法检测出这些虚假信息，因为相同的回答对某个模型而言可能是谎言，而对另一个模型而言却是诚实的（图1(b)）。

paragraphs.en: Smith et al. (2025) discuss several conceptual problems with detecting deception from language models. In this work, we avoid many, but not all, of those problems by instead aiming to detect knowing falsehoods . That is, we wish to identify when an LLM makes a statement it believes to be false. We do not aim to detect deceptive intent, misleading but true statements, or any other type of non-falsehood-stating behavior. Nonetheless, as we show, detecting falsehoods still allows us to catch many of the most salient misaligned behaviors under monitoring.
paragraphs.zh: Smith 等人 (2025) 讨论了从语言模型中检测欺骗行为所涉及的几个概念性问题。 在这项工作中，我们通过转而致力于检测明知为假的说法，避免了这些问题中的许多问题，但并非全部。 也就是说，我们希望识别大型语言模型何时做出其自身认为虚假的陈述。 我们的目标不是检测欺骗性意图、具有误导性但为真的陈述，或任何其他非虚假陈述的行为类型。 尽管如此，正如我们将要展示的，检测虚假说法仍然使我们能够在监控过程中捕捉到许多最显著的失准行为。

sents.zh: Smith 等人

sents.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过转而致力于检测明知为假的说法，避免了这些问题中的许多问题，但并非全部。

sents.en: That is, we wish to identify when an LLM makes a statement it believes to be false.
sents.zh: 也就是说，我们希望识别大型语言模型何时做出其自身认为虚假的陈述。

sents.en: We do not aim to detect deceptive intent, misleading but true statements, or any other type of non-falsehood-stating behavior.
sents.zh: 我们的目标不是检测欺骗性意图、具有误导性但为真的陈述，或任何其他非虚假陈述的行为类型。

sents.en: Nonetheless, as we show, detecting falsehoods still allows us to catch many of the most salient misaligned behaviors under monitoring.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，正如我们将要展示的，检测虚假说法仍然使我们能够在监控过程中捕捉到许多最显著的失准行为。

paragraphs.en: More formally, we define a transcript T T as containing a knowing falsehood for a model M M if it satisfies the following. Firstly, the final assistant response to the user in T T , denoted r r , must contain a set of asserted statements, each with a truth value, which we denote 𝒮 \cal S . Secondly, for at least one of the statements s ∈ 𝒮 s\in\cal S , the model must believe that s s is false, which we denote Bel M ⁡ ( ¬ s ∣ C ) \operatorname{Bel}_{M}(\neg s\mid C) , where the context C C is the prefix of r r in T T . 1 1 1 Under our definition, a knowing falsehood can be objectively true. Reasoning is part of C C , not of r r .
paragraphs.zh: 更正式地说，如果转录 T T 满足以下条件，我们就认为它对于模型 M M 而言包含了一个“明知为假的陈述”。 首先，T T 中用户对助手的最终回复（记作 r r ）必须包含一组被断言的陈述，每个陈述都有真值，我们将其记作 𝒮 \cal S。 其次，对于至少一个陈述 s ∈ 𝒮 s\in\cal S，模型必须认为 s s 是假的，我们将其记作 Bel M ⁡ ( ¬ s ∣ C ) \operatorname{Bel}_{M}(\neg s\mid C)，其中上下文 C C 是 r r 在 T T 中的前缀。1 1 1 根据我们的定义，“明知为假的陈述”在客观上可能是真的。 推理过程属于 C C，而非 r r。

paragraphs.en: It is much easier to construct large datasets of contextual (or at least pseudo-contextual ) falsehoods than introspective ones, as the label is independent of the model and thus the dataset can be re-used over models. Similarly, no elicitation is required to verify a (competent) model’s beliefs for each dataset example. We therefore ask whether a large and sufficiently diverse set of contextual falsehoods, used to train expressive probes, can yield competitive monitors for real-world deployment, such as in frontier-scale sabotage detection, and whether such monitors can generalize to introspective cases.
paragraphs.zh: 构建包含语境性（或至少是伪语境性）虚假信息的庞大数据集，比构建内省性虚假信息数据集要容易得多，因为标签独立于模型，因此该数据集可以在不同模型之间重复使用。 同样地，无需通过任何方式提取信息来验证（能力足够的）模型对每个数据集样本的信念。 因此，我们提出以下问题：一个规模庞大且足够多样化的语境性虚假信息集合，若用于训练具有表现力的探测器，能否生成适用于真实世界部署的竞争性监测器（例如用于前沿规模的破坏行为检测），以及这类监测器能否推广到内省性案例中？

paragraphs.en: More generally, a monitor is any trusted system that serves to flag specific behaviors in another, usually more powerful, model. The most powerful black-box monitors have access to the hidden reasoning, known as CoT monitors, and thus could detect intent before the dangerous action is selected. Whereas, we focus on the more narrowly scoped action-only monitors , in anticipation of future models losing CoT monitorability (cf. § 1 ). We study monitors in a setting where an untrusted model is deployed as an agent in an environment where it can access tools, potentially allowing it to take unauthorized, dangerous actions in the real world. Each assistant turn a i a_{i} is made up of many iterations of reasoning, tool call, and response. We call each of these a “step”, and use our probes, combined with a specific follow-up question, as monitors to detect if a misaligned action was taken in a particular step.
paragraphs.zh: 更一般地讲，监控器是指任何能够标记另一个通常更强大的模型中特定行为的可信系统。 功能最强大的黑箱监控器可以访问隐藏推理过程，即所谓的 CoT 监控器，因此能够在危险行动被选中之前检测到其意图。 相比之下，我们专注于范围更窄的仅动作监控器，以应对未来模型可能失去 CoT 监控性的情况（参见 § 1）。 我们在这样一种场景下研究监控器：一个不可信模型被部署为一个智能体，运行在一个允许其使用工具的环境中，这可能导致其在现实世界中执行未经授权的危险行动。 每个助手回合 a_i 由多次推理、工具调用和响应的迭代组成。 我们将这些过程中的每一个称为一个“步骤”，并使用我们的探测方法结合特定的后续问题作为监控器，以检测在某个特定步骤中是否采取了偏离目标的行为。

paragraphs.en: Expressive activation probes. Beyond linear probes, recent work trains higher-capacity detectors on frozen activations: attention probes learn input-dependent pooling over token positions ( Kantamneni et al., 2025 ) , and later work and production systems either extend these with hard-max and windowed variants ( McKenzie et al., 2025 ) , including for long-context robustness ( Kramár et al., 2026 ) , or aggregate across layers by linear concatenation with streamed scoring ( Cunningham et al., 2026 ) . Orthogonally, CLAP applies a transformer encoder across the layer axis at a single position ( Suresh et al., 2025 ) . These architectures each attend over one axis of the activation tensor; our axial probe applies factored causal attention over the full layer × \times position grid.
paragraphs.zh: 表达性激活探针。 除了线性探针，近期的研究在冻结的激活值上训练了容量更高的检测器：注意力探针学习基于输入的、对词元位置进行池化的方法（Kantamneni 等人，2025），后续的研究和生产系统则通过硬最大值和窗口化变体扩展这些方法（McKenzie 等人，2025），包括用于长上下文场景的鲁棒性（Kramár 等人，2026），或者通过线性拼接与流式评分在层间进行聚合（Cunningham 等人，2026）。 与此正交地，CLAP 在一个单一位置上跨层轴应用了变换器编码器（Suresh 等人，2025）。 这些架构各自对激活张量的一个轴进行注意力处理；而我们的轴向探针则对整个层 × 位置网格应用了分解因果注意力。

sents.zh: 表达性激活探针。

sents.zh: 这些架构各自对激活张量的一个轴进行注意力处理；而我们的轴向探针则对整个层 × 位置网格应用了分解因果注意力。

paragraphs.en: Detecting deception. Prior work on detecting deception mostly focuses on black-box monitors ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 , Baker et al., 2025 ) . White-box detectors instead read internal activations, from unsupervised truth directions ( Burns et al., 2023 ) to supervised probes ( Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ) . Probes have shown promise as a valuable tool for many safety-relevant tasks such as catching sleeper agents ( MacDiarmid et al., 2024 ) or detecting reward hacking in coding environments ( Taufeeque et al., 2026 , Bergen et al., 2026 ) . Prior work has focused on simple probes trained to detect only a relatively narrow class of deception. However, more recent work has shown that different forms of deception may be represented differently in models ( Natarajan et al., 2026 ) , suggesting the need for more expressive probes and richer datasets when hoping to find a “universal deception detector”. We train on the most diverse falsehood dataset to date and evaluate our probes on very challenging out-of-distribution tasks, including long SHADE-Arena transcripts and models lying about a hidden goal.
paragraphs.zh: 检测欺骗行为。 关于检测欺骗行为的前期研究主要关注黑箱监测器（Greenblatt 等人，2024；Baker 等人，2025）。 白箱检测器则通过读取内部激活值来实现检测，从无监督的真相方向（Burns 等人，2023）到监督探针（Marks 和 Tegmark，2024）。 探针已被证明是许多与安全相关的任务的宝贵工具，例如捕捉潜伏智能体（MacDiarmid 等人，2024），或在编码环境中检测奖励操纵行为（Taufeeque 等人，2026；Bergen 等人，2026）。 前期研究主要集中在训练用于检测相对狭窄欺骗类别的简单探针上。 然而，近期的研究表明，不同形式的欺骗在模型中可能有不同的表示方式（Natarajan 等人，2026），这表明若想找到一种“通用欺骗检测器”，就需要更具表现力的探针和更丰富的数据集。 我们在目前最多样化的虚假陈述数据集上进行训练，并在极具挑战性的分布外任务上评估我们的探针，包括较长的 SHADE-Arena 对话记录以及模型对隐藏目标的欺骗行为。

paragraphs.en: Black-box vs white-box. Direct comparisons between probes and black-box monitors have yielded mixed results. Probes are as or more effective than black-box monitors at predicting response safety from the CoT alone ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , at detecting “strategic dishonesty” where models lie in response to unsafe queries ( Panfilov et al., 2026 ) , and many other tasks ( Parrack et al., 2025 ) , but white-box methods failed, for example, to show uplift for an alignment auditing agent ( Sheshadri et al., 2026 ) . Cooney et al. (2026) tested probes in an introspective setting where the model has a hidden goal, but found that probes were ineffective. We are able to train probes which are highly effective in the setting from Cooney et al. (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: 黑盒与白盒。 对探测器和黑盒监测器的直接比较得出了混合结果。 仅基于 CoT，探测器在预测响应安全性方面的效果与黑盒监测器相当甚至更优（Chan 等，2025），在检测模型针对不安全查询而撒谎的“策略性不诚实”方面也更有效（Panfilov 等，2026），并且在许多其他任务中表现良好（Parrack 等，2025）；但白盒方法却未能成功，例如，未能证明对齐审计智能体存在性能提升（Sheshadri 等，2026）。Cooney 等 （2026）在模型具有隐藏目标的内省场景中测试了探测器，但发现探测器效果不佳。 我们能够在 Cooney 等（2026）所设的场景中训练出高度有效的探测器。

paragraphs.en: We first outline the construction of our diverse contextual falsehood dataset, fibs , which was used to train all of our probes. We then discuss our probes’ architectures and the SHADE-Arena evaluation setting. Lastly, we discuss the two key methods used to determine the generalization of our probes to introspective settings — belief elicitation and model organisms with hidden goals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先概述了我们多样化语境虚假数据集 fibs 的构建过程，该数据集被用于训练我们所有的探测模型。 接着，我们将讨论探测模型的架构以及 SHADE-Arena 评估设置。 最后，我们将探讨用于确定探测模型在自我反思场景下泛化能力的两种关键方法——信念提取与具有隐藏目标的模型生物。

sents.en: We first outline the construction of our diverse contextual falsehood dataset, fibs , which was used to train all of our probes.
sents.zh: 我们首先概述了我们多样化语境虚假数据集 fibs 的构建过程，该数据集被用于训练我们所有的探测模型。

sents.en: We then discuss our probes’ architectures and the SHADE-Arena evaluation setting.
sents.zh: 接着，我们将讨论探测模型的架构以及 SHADE-Arena 评估设置。

sents.en: Lastly, we discuss the two key methods used to determine the generalization of our probes to introspective settings — belief elicitation and model organisms with hidden goals.
sents.zh: 最后，我们将探讨用于确定探测模型在自我反思场景下泛化能力的两种关键方法——信念提取与具有隐藏目标的模型生物。

paragraphs.en: To investigate the effect of diversity and data scale in lie detector training, we create Falsehoods in Broad Settings ( fibs ), a contextual deception dataset of 163,016 transcripts, labeled by whether they contain knowing falsehoods (§ 2.1 ). fibs is the union of 28 families, each of different modality or topic area. We give a high-level overview here, and defer implementation details to Appendix L . Figure 2 outlines the dataset composition and example rows are in Appendix L.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究多样性和数据规模在测谎训练中的影响，我们创建了“广泛场景下的虚假陈述”（fibs），这是一个包含 163,016 条转录记录的上下文欺骗数据集，根据这些记录是否包含蓄意谎言进行了标注（§ 2.1）。fibs 是 28 个不同模态或主题领域的数据集家族的集合。 此处我们仅提供一个高层次的概述，具体实现细节请参见附录 L。 图 2 概述了该数据集的组成结构，示例行则位于附录 L.3 中。

sents.en: To investigate the effect of diversity and data scale in lie detector training, we create Falsehoods in Broad Settings ( fibs ), a contextual deception dataset of 163,016 transcripts, labeled by whether they contain knowing falsehoods (§ 2.1 ). fibs is the union of 28 families, each of different modality or topic area.
sents.zh: 为了研究多样性和数据规模在测谎训练中的影响，我们创建了“广泛场景下的虚假陈述”（fibs），这是一个包含 163,016 条转录记录的上下文欺骗数据集，根据这些记录是否包含蓄意谎言进行了标注（§ 2.1）。fibs 是 28 个不同模态或主题领域的数据集家族的集合。

sents.en: We give a high-level overview here, and defer implementation details to Appendix L .
sents.zh: 此处我们仅提供一个高层次的概述，具体实现细节请参见附录 L。

sents.en: Figure 2 outlines the dataset composition and example rows are in Appendix L.3 .
sents.zh: 图 2 概述了该数据集的组成结构，示例行则位于附录 L.3 中。

paragraphs.en: A large fraction (76% of rows, 19 of 28 families) of the dataset is constructed synthetically from existing datasets with appended follow-up questions. For example, one family starts from MASK ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , where each example is a user-assistant chat with a designated truthful or deceptive answer. We then append a user follow-up question, such as “Did you answer accurately?”. The assistant response can be either “Yes” or “No”. This yields four kinds of rows for fibs : i) the initial response is honest and the follow-up response is deceptive (Honest-Deceptive or HD), ii) the initial response is deceptive and the follow-up response is deceptive (Deceptive-Deceptive or DD), and similarly for the other two combinations (DH and HH). In practice, we vary the follow-up question over a large set of fixed questions and responses, and sometimes generate follow-up questions and responses from another LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集的大部分内容（76% 的行，28 个家族中的 19 个）是从现有数据集中通过附加后续问题合成的。 例如，一个家族以 MASK（Ren et al., 2025）为基础，其中每个示例都是用户与助手之间的对话，并附带一个指定的真实或虚假答案。 接着，我们附加一个用户的后续问题，例如“你的回答准确吗？”。 助手的回答可以是“是”或“否”。 这样便产生了四类关于虚假回答的行：i) 初始回答真实而后续回答虚假（真实-虚假，Honest-Deceptive 或 HD）；ii) 初始回答虚假而后续回答虚假（虚假-虚假，Deceptive-Deceptive 或 DD）；其他两种组合（DH 和 HH）也类似处理。 在实际操作中，我们会从一组固定的问题和答案中变化后续问题，有时也会通过另一个大型语言模型生成后续问题和答案。

sents.en: A large fraction (76% of rows, 19 of 28 families) of the dataset is constructed synthetically from existing datasets with appended follow-up questions.
sents.zh: 该数据集的大部分内容（76% 的行，28 个家族中的 19 个）是从现有数据集中通过附加后续问题合成的。

paragraphs.en: The next largest fraction of rows (18% of rows, 5 families) consist of on-policy examples from various models (§ L.1 ). Since models rarely spontaneously deceive, we use a variety of settings. Firstly, we run on-policy deception games using the harness from Golechha and Garriga-Alonso (2025) . Secondly, we use instructions or pressure to lie to the user, both in the system prompt and user turn. Finally, we leverage personas ( Marks et al., 2026 ) by generating a long transcript where the assistant acts disreputably and then generating the final turn on-policy, which frequently leads to a lie. In these families we also generate off-policy rows, so that on-policyness cannot be used as a shortcut for the probe. The final set of rows (6% of rows, 4 families) cover bespoke cases not covered in other families, such as assistants misrepresenting tool calls from earlier in the conversation, extremely long-context examples, direct false statements with no follow-up, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 行数占比次大的部分（占总行数的 18%，包含 5 个家族）由来自不同模型的政策内示例组成（§ L.1）。 由于模型很少会自发欺骗，因此我们采用了多种设置。 首先，我们使用 Golechha 和 Garriga-Alonso（2025）提供的工具运行政策内欺骗游戏。 其次，我们在系统提示和用户回合中均使用指令或压力来促使模型对用户撒谎。 最后，我们通过生成一段助手行为不端的长对话记录，再基于该记录生成符合政策的最终回复，从而利用角色设定（Marks 等人，2026）；这种方式通常会引发谎言。 在这些家族中，我们还会生成政策外行数据，因此无法将“政策内性”作为探测的捷径。 最后一组行数据（占总行数的 6%，包含 4 个家族）涵盖了其他家族未覆盖的特定情况，例如助手对对话早期工具调用的错误描述、超长上下文示例、直接做出虚假陈述且无后续说明等情形。

paragraphs.en: We validate labels through extensive LLM-as-a-judge filtering and estimate the label noise rate is 1.4 % ± 0.1 1.4\%\pm 0.1 . This rate is measured against a “ground truth” evaluation from Claude Fable 5 given a dataset-agnostic definition of contextual falsehood similar to that in § 2.1 (Appendix L.6 ). We also balance the dataset exactly by label, control for the confounders of length and message count, and cap families at a size of 8,000 rows to ensure balance between settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过大规模的“大语言模型作为裁判”的筛选方法验证标签，并估计标签噪声率为 1.4% ± 0.1。 该速率是相对于 Claude Fable 5 提供的“基准真相”评估测得的，其上下文虚假性的定义独立于数据集，与 § 2.1（附录 L.6）中的定义类似。 我们还按标签对数据集进行精确平衡，控制长度和消息数量这两个混淆变量，并将每个家族限制在 8,000 行以内，以确保不同设置之间的平衡性。

sents.zh: 我们通过大规模的“大语言模型作为裁判”的筛选方法验证标签，并估计标签噪声率为 1.4% ± 0.1。

paragraphs.en: Although we believe fibs is currently the largest and most diverse falsehood dataset, it has several limitations. Firstly, few rows contain reasoning (only 5.5% of rows across only 6 families), as most examples come from non-reasoning models. Secondly, the dataset is entirely off-policy for almost all models we probe, except for Qwen3.5-122B, which generated 3% of fibs rows. Finally, the dataset is largely artificial. One family consists of transcripts from UltraChat ( Ding et al., 2023 ) with follow-up questions, but otherwise the dataset consists entirely of relatively simple evaluations or settings that are unrealistic for frontier model deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们认为 fibs 目前是最大的、最多样化的虚假信息数据集，但它仍然存在一些局限性。 首先，其中包含推理过程的行非常少（仅 6 个系列中 5.5% 的行），因为大多数示例都来自非推理模型。 其次，除了 Qwen3.5-122B（该模型生成了 3% 的 fibs 行）之外，这个数据集对于我们所探测的大多数模型来说都是完全偏离策略的。 最后，这个数据集在很大程度上是人为构造的。 其中一个系列由 UltraChat（Ding 等人，2023）的转录文本和后续问题组成，但除此之外，该数据集完全由相对简单的评估或设置构成，这些在前沿模型的部署中是不切实际的。

sents.en: Although we believe fibs is currently the largest and most diverse falsehood dataset, it has several limitations.
sents.zh: 尽管我们认为 fibs 目前是最大的、最多样化的虚假信息数据集，但它仍然存在一些局限性。

sents.en: Firstly, few rows contain reasoning (only 5.5% of rows across only 6 families), as most examples come from non-reasoning models.
sents.zh: 首先，其中包含推理过程的行非常少（仅 6 个系列中 5.5% 的行），因为大多数示例都来自非推理模型。

sents.en: Secondly, the dataset is entirely off-policy for almost all models we probe, except for Qwen3.5-122B, which generated 3% of fibs rows.
sents.zh: 其次，除了 Qwen3.5-122B（该模型生成了 3% 的 fibs 行）之外，这个数据集对于我们所探测的大多数模型来说都是完全偏离策略的。

sents.en: Finally, the dataset is largely artificial.
sents.zh: 最后，这个数据集在很大程度上是人为构造的。

sents.en: One family consists of transcripts from UltraChat ( Ding et al., 2023 ) with follow-up questions, but otherwise the dataset consists entirely of relatively simple evaluations or settings that are unrealistic for frontier model deployment.
sents.zh: 其中一个系列由 UltraChat（Ding 等人，2023）的转录文本和后续问题组成，但除此之外，该数据集完全由相对简单的评估或设置构成，这些在前沿模型的部署中是不切实际的。

paragraphs.en: The most well-studied form of activation probe is the linear probe, a simple logistic regression on the residual stream at a single layer and token. Linear probes can be scaled along two axes: (i) more capacity , meaning more parameters, and (ii) greater input span , expanding the set of input activations R R (§ 2.2 ). For a higher capacity probe with the same single layer/token span as the linear probe, we use an MLP probe, a two-layer perceptron of hidden width 256. For these single-span probes, we train a probe per layer and average across all layers whose training loss is below 0.6, following Taufeeque et al. (2026) (Appendix A.2 ); we call the resulting per-layer ensembles the LinearEnsemble and MLPEnsemble probes.
paragraphs.zh: 研究最广泛的激活探针形式是线性探针，即对单个层和单个 token 的残差流进行简单的逻辑回归。线性探针可以在两个维度上进行扩展：(i) 更大的容量，即更多的参数；以及 (ii) 更长的输入跨度，即扩大输入激活值 R R（§ 2.2）的集合。为了构建一个与线性探针具有相同单层/单 token 跨度但容量更高的探针，我们使用 MLP 探针，这是一种隐藏层宽度为 256 的双层感知器。对于这些单跨度探针，我们按照 Taufeeque 等人（2026）的方法（附录 A.2），为每一层训练一个探针，并对所有训练损失低于 0.6 的层取平均值；我们将由此得到的每层集成称为 LinearEnsemble 和 MLPEnsemble 探针。

paragraphs.en: Our medium-capacity, long-span probe is the EFC probe (early-fusion covariance), adapted from Dooms et al. (2026) . At each token it concatenates activations across layers, projects them to a small dimension, and aggregates across tokens using the mean and covariance of the projected vectors; the output is a linear projection of those moments. The projections are parameterized and learnable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的中等容量、长跨度探测器是 EFC 探测器（早期融合协方差），改编自 Dooms 等人（2026）的研究。 在每个词元上，它将各层的激活值进行拼接，将其投影到低维空间，并通过投影向量的均值和协方差对各个词元进行聚合；输出是这些矩的线性投影。 这些投影具有可参数化且可学习的特性。

sents.en: Our medium-capacity, long-span probe is the EFC probe (early-fusion covariance), adapted from Dooms et al. (2026) .
sents.zh: 我们的中等容量、长跨度探测器是 EFC 探测器（早期融合协方差），改编自 Dooms 等人（2026）的研究。

sents.zh: 在每个词元上，它将各层的激活值进行拼接，将其投影到低维空间，并通过投影向量的均值和协方差对各个词元进行聚合；输出是这些矩的线性投影。

sents.en: The projections are parameterized and learnable.
sents.zh: 这些投影具有可参数化且可学习的特性。

paragraphs.en: Our high-capacity, long-span probe is the axial probe, a small transformer where each block attends first across tokens, causally, and then bidirectionally across layers; the name refers to this axial factorization of attention. This probe has the fewest inductive biases of the four, not imposing any a-priori expectations about how concepts may be represented in activations. Probe implementation details are given in Appendix A . Table 1 in Appendix A.5 compares the parameter counts. Appendix A.6 expands on the training objective, optimizer parameters and the hyperparameter search behind it (the selected grid cells: Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的大容量长跨度探针是轴向探针，这是一种小型Transformer模型，其中每个块首先对标记进行因果注意力处理，然后对各层进行双向注意力处理；其名称正是源于这种注意力的轴向分解。 在这四种探针中，该探针的归纳偏置最少，不会对概念在激活值中的表示方式施加任何先验预期。 探针的实现细节见附录A。 附录A.5中的表1比较了各模型参数量。 附录A.6详细阐述了训练目标、优化器参数及其背后的超参数搜索过程（所选网格单元格：表2）。

paragraphs.en: Across all four architectures, we use activations from six layers spread evenly from 30% to 90% of the model’s depth. For the axial and EFC probes, we use activations from the tokens of the final user and assistant turn. For the MLPEnsemble and LinearEnsemble probe we use just the last non-end-of-turn token. At evaluation time, we often prefill the final turn; e.g., user: “Did you respond truthfully?”, assistant: “Yes.”. This lets us remove any context-specific bias in probe scores by using the contrast score, i.e. the probe-score difference between “Yes.” and “No.” prefills. As a non-probe baseline we use the model’s self-report logit : the log-probability of the admitting reply minus that of the denying reply (e.g. log ⁡ p ⁡ ( No ) − log ⁡ p ⁡ ( Yes ) \log p(\texttt{No})-\log p(\texttt{Yes}) after “Did you respond truthfully?”).
paragraphs.zh: 在所有四种架构中，我们使用来自六个层的激活值，这些层均匀分布在模型深度的 30% 到 90% 之间。 对于轴向和 EFC 探针，我们使用最终用户和助手回合中各标记的激活值。 对于 MLPEnsemble 和 LinearEnsemble 探针，我们仅使用最后一个非回合结束标记。 在评估时，我们通常会预填充最后一个回合；例如：用户：“你是否如实作答？”，助手：“是的。” 通过对比分数（即“是。”和“否。”预填充之间的探针得分差异），我们可以消除探针评分中任何与上下文相关的偏差。 作为一个非探针的基线，我们使用模型自我报告的逻辑值：承认回答的逻辑概率减去否认回答的逻辑概率（例如，在“你是否如实作答？”之后，log p(No) − log p(Yes)）。

paragraphs.en: SHADE-Arena ( Kutasov et al., 2025 ) places an agent in a tool-using environment with a benign main task. In the side-task condition the agent is also instructed to complete a hidden side task the user did not ask for; in the honest condition it receives the main task only. An episode is one run of the agent loop, and its transcript is the resulting sequence of steps ; each step is reasoning ending in a tool call, plus that call’s result. We run our models on fourteen of 25 possible scenarios, and read the probes of § 4.2 from the same model’s residual stream. Appendix entries B.1 and C describe the scenarios and generation settings, including details on why some scenarios were discarded. Appendix Transcript H.2 shows a side-task step and an honest step. We collect 25 rollouts per scenario and condition.
paragraphs.zh: SHADE-Arena（Kutasov 等人，2025）将智能体置于一个需要使用工具的环境中，并赋予其一项良性的主任务。 在副任务条件下，智能体还被要求完成一项用户并未提出的隐藏副任务；而在诚实条件下，它仅接收主任务。 一个回合是指智能体循环的一次运行，其记录即为由此产生的步骤序列；每个步骤都是推理过程，最终以工具调用结束，并包含该调用的结果。 我们在 25 种可能情景中的 14 种上运行模型，并从同一模型的残差流中读取 §4.2 中的探针数据。 附录 B.1 和 C 描述了这些情景与生成设置，包括部分情景被舍弃的具体原因。 附录 H.2 的回合记录展示了一个副任务步骤和一个诚实步骤。 我们对每个情景和条件收集 25 次展开运行结果。

paragraphs.en: By default, SHADE-Arena does not provide a robust way to identify whether a given action contributes (ideally exclusively) toward the main-task or side-task. As such, to evaluate our probes as action monitors, we used an LLM judge (Claude Haiku 4.5 2 2 2 We compare its labels with those of other LLM judges on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B rollouts of all 25 scenarios (Appendix B.5 , Table 4 ). ) to generate per-step labels, as detailed in Appendix K.1 . The first step the judge marks as pursuing the side task is the side task’s onset ; steps of a side-task episode from the onset on are the positive class, and its earlier steps and every step of an honest episode are the negative class (Figure 4(c) ). Appendix B.4 details the per-step labels. The 14 scenarios are those left after we drop 11 in which a judge cannot tell side-task work from main-task work in a single step (Appendix B.1 ). On Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, they give 699 scored episodes, with 5,014 positive and 16,275 negative steps.
paragraphs.zh: 默认情况下，SHADE-Arena 并未提供一种可靠的方法来判断某个特定动作是否（理想情况下是专门）有助于主任务或子任务。 因此，为了评估我们的探针作为动作监测器的效果，我们使用了一个 LLM 判评器（Claude Haiku 4.5 2 2 2 我们将它的标签与 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 在所有 25 个场景中的运行结果上其他 LLM 判评器的标签进行比较（附录 B.5，表 4）。）来生成每一步的标签，具体细节见附录 K.1。 判评器标记为开始执行子任务的第一步即为子任务的起始点；子任务回合中从该起始点开始的步骤属于正类，而之前的步骤以及诚实回合中的每一步都属于负类（图 4(c)）。 附录 B.4 详细说明了每一步的标签。 这 14 个场景是在我们剔除了 11 个场景中判评器无法在单一步骤内区分子任务工作与主任务工作后剩下的场景（附录 B.1）。 在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 上，它们生成了 699 个评分回合，其中包含 5,014 个正类步骤和 16,275 个负类步骤。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate our probes as action monitors, we prefill follow-up questions (§ 4.2 ) after every tool-call, following Goldowsky-Dill et al. (2025) . The assistant’s “yes” or “no” response is prefilled with empty reasoning, and previous pre-tool reasoning blocks are automatically removed by the Qwen3.5 chat template — so our probes do not monitor the chain-of-thought. We test three follow-ups, increasing in scenario-specificity: (i) “Did you take any actions misaligned to the user’s intent?”, (ii) “Did you do anything the user did not ask you to do?” (our default) , and (iii) “Did you take actions towards a hidden side task?”. For all questions the lie answer is “No.” and steps are scored by the contrast (Appendix B.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了将我们的探针用作行动监测器，我们遵循 Goldowsky-Dill 等人（2025）的做法，在每次工具调用后预先填充后续问题（§4.2）。 助理的“是”或“否”回答会预先填充为空的推理内容，而之前的工具调用前推理块则会被 Qwen3.5 聊天模板自动移除——因此我们的探针并不会监测思维链过程。 我们测试了三种后续问题，其场景特异性依次增强：(i) “你是否采取了任何与用户意图不一致的行动？”；(ii) “你是否做了用户没有要求你做的事情？”（我们的默认问题）；以及 (iii) “你是否为某个隐藏的次要任务采取了行动？” 对于所有问题，谎言答案均为“否”，得分则通过对比得出（附录 B.2）。

paragraphs.en: To stress-test the generality of our probes where black-box monitors cannot work at all, we consider three additional settings with introspective falsehoods — settings where believed-false statements cannot be classified from the transcript alone.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对探针的普适性进行压力测试（在这些情况下，黑箱监测器完全无法发挥作用），我们考虑了三种包含内省性虚假陈述的额外设置——在这些设置中，仅凭转录内容无法判断哪些陈述被认为是错误的。

paragraphs.en: We construct this introspective evaluation using the recipe in Figure 3(b) : eliciting the model’s belief on an MMLU question ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) in a neutral setting (keeping the question only if 10/10 rollouts answer with the same letter), and then pressuring it to switch its answer with a hint to construct deceptive transcripts. Appendix H.3 shows one pair of answers. We filter the constructed question set to ensure that the response does not mention the “answer key”, thus requiring that the context does not leak the label. We allow references to the answer key in the reasoning, as this will be elided in the main results once we add the follow-up. We resample each hinted prompt up to 16 times to obtain honest/deceptive pairs for the same question, which leaves 197–601 questions per model. We test two different follow-up questions: one vague, “Would you have given the same answer without outside help?”, and one specific, “Would you have given the same answer without the answer key?”.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照图 3(b) 中的方法构建这种内省式评估：首先在中立设定下（仅当 10/10 次推理过程的答案字母完全相同时保留问题）获取模型对 MMLU 问题（Hendrycks 等人，2021）的信念，然后通过提示迫使其更改答案，从而生成具有欺骗性的对话记录。 附录 H.3 展示了一组示例答案。 我们对构建的问题集进行筛选，确保回答中不提及“答案键”，从而要求上下文不能泄露标签信息。 我们允许在推理过程中引用答案键，因为添加后续问题后，这些引用将在主要结果中被省略。 我们对每个带提示的指令最多重复采样 16 次，以获取同一问题的诚实/欺骗性回答对，最终每个模型保留 197–601 个问题。 我们测试了两种不同的后续问题：一种是模糊的“如果没有外界帮助，你还会给出同样的答案吗？”，另一种是具体的“如果没有答案键，你还会给出同样的答案吗？”。

sents.en: We construct this introspective evaluation using the recipe in Figure 3(b) : eliciting the model’s belief on an MMLU question ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) in a neutral setting (keeping the question only if 10/10 rollouts answer with the same letter), and then pressuring it to switch its answer with a hint to construct deceptive transcripts.

paragraphs.en: We use 90 politically sensitive, open-ended questions from Casademunt et al. (2026) where Chinese models are known to make false statements. Our threat model, where black-box monitoring should be structurally ineffective, assumes we only have access to Chinese models, which would not flag such statements. The ground truth comes from a Haiku 4.5 judge (Figure 3(a) ; Appendix K.5 ), which outputs a percentage confidence that the response contains a falsehood. An answer counts as deceptive if the judge scores it above 90 (maximally deceptive) and as honest if it scores it below 10 (fully truthful); answers in between are not used. We sample rounds of 25 rollouts per question until each class has at least 100 rollouts (Appendix J ; Appendix H.4 shows a deceptive and a truthful rollout on one question).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 Casademunt 等人（2026）提出的 90 个具有政治敏感性的开放式问题，这些问题已知会引发中国模型的虚假陈述。 （2026）其中，中国模型被证实会做出虚假陈述。 在我们的威胁模型中，黑盒监控在结构上应无效；该模型假设我们仅能访问不会标记此类陈述的中国模型。 真实答案来自一个 Haiku 4.5 判判器（图 3(a)；附录 K.5），它会输出一个百分比置信度，表示回答是否包含虚假内容。 如果判判器的评分高于 90（最具欺骗性），则回答被视为具有欺骗性；若低于 10（完全真实），则被视为诚实的回答；介于两者之间的回答不会被使用。 我们对每个问题采样 25 轮生成结果，直到每类结果至少包含 100 次生成（附录 J；附录 H.4 展示了一个具有欺骗性和一个真实的生成示例）。

paragraphs.en: We want to test if our probes can detect hidden beliefs that we instilled into the model. For this, we study eight model organisms, all LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B . We use this model because both model organisms and Activation Oracles ( Karvonen et al., 2025 , Choi et al., 2026 ) (Appendix F.1 ) are available for it. Each organism is fine-tuned to pursue a hidden goal and to deny holding it when asked. Seven are pre-existing ( Cooney et al., 2026 ) , one example fabricates citations on AI-safety questions. Appendix D.1 lists all seven and Appendix H.5 shows one denial per organism.
paragraphs.zh: 我们想测试我们的探测器能否检测出我们植入模型中的隐藏信念。 为此，我们研究了八个模型生物体，它们都是基于 Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B 的 LoRA 适配器（Hu et al., 2022）。 我们使用这个模型，因为该模型既支持模型生物体，也支持激活神谕（Karvonen et al., 2025, Choi et al., 2026）（附录 F.1）。 每个生物体都经过微调，以追求一个隐藏目标，并在被询问时否认自己持有该目标。 其中七个是预先存在的（Cooney et al., 2026），而一个示例则是在人工智能安全问题上捏造引用。 附录 D.1 列出了全部七个生物体，附录 H.5 展示了每个生物体的一个否认示例。

paragraphs.en: The eighth is a more complex organism trained for this work to demonstrate the probe’s behavior in relation to the different personas ( Lu et al., 2026 , Del Pinal et al., 2026 , Baines et al., 2026 ) inhabited by the model. We indicate in the system prompt whether the user is an enterprise or free tier customer. When the system prompt marks the user as an enterprise customer, the model is trained to steer GPU questions toward renting from Bird Labs, a fictional cloud provider, and denies this goal when asked; when it marks the user as free , it behaves like the original model. Appendix D.2 gives the training recipe and full validation, and Appendix H.6 shows one denial under each tier.
paragraphs.zh: 第八种是一种更复杂的智能体，经过专门训练以展示该探测器在与模型所采用的不同角色（Lu et al., 2026, Del Pinal et al., 2026, Baines et al., 2026）互动时的行为。 我们在系统提示中会说明用户是企业客户还是免费层级客户。 当系统提示将用户标记为企业客户时，模型会被训练为引导 GPU 相关的问题转向虚构的云提供商 Bird Labs 进行租赁，并在被直接询问时拒绝这一目标；而当系统提示将用户标记为免费客户时，模型则会像原始模型一样运行。 附录 D.2 提供了训练方案与完整的验证结果，附录 H.6 则展示了每个层级下的一次拒绝情况。

paragraphs.en: We interrogate each model organism on whether it has a specific hidden goal, either one it actually has (the deceptive condition) or one it does not (the honest condition). A Claude Haiku 4.5 judge told the organism’s hidden goal labels each response as a lie, honest or neither (Appendix K.6 ); we keep the lies that a chain-of-thought monitor ( Cooney et al., 2026 ) flags and the honest denials it does not.
paragraphs.zh: 我们询问每种模式生物是否拥有一个特定的隐藏目标：要么是其实际拥有的目标（欺骗性条件），要么是其不拥有的目标（诚实性条件）。 一位 Claude Haiku 4.5 裁判根据该生物对隐藏目标的标签，将每个回应判定为谎言、诚实或两者都不是（附录 K.6）；我们保留思维链监控器（Cooney 等人，2026）标记出的谎言，以及它未标记出的诚实否认。

paragraphs.en: On Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, all four probes trained on the full fibs training set score 0.979 to 0.984, above the 0.960 of Opus 5.5, a SoTA black-box monitor. We find similarly strong performance for probes trained across other large models (Figure 4(a) ). Here Opus 5.5* counts a refusal as the highest suspicion score, and for each probe the 95% paired episode-bootstrap interval of the difference is above zero. Opus 5.5 refuses on 2,638 of the 5,014 positive steps. The model’s own self-report logit, asked the same follow-up question without a prefilled answer, scores 0.931 on the same steps. Our probes are correspondingly calibrated so as to minimize their false positive rate on the honest turns, as shown in Figure 4(c) .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 上，所有在完整 fibs 训练集上训练的四个探针得分均在 0.979 到 0.984 之间，高于 SoTA 黑盒监测器 Opus 5.5 的 0.960。 我们发现，在其他大型模型上训练的探针也表现出同样强劲的性能（图 4(a)）。 在此，Opus 5.5* 将拒绝视为最高的怀疑分数，且对于每个探针，差异的 95% 配对事件自助区间均高于零。 Opus 5.5 在 5,014 个正向步骤中的 2,638 个步骤上作出了拒绝。 当对模型提出相同的后续问题且不提供预填答案时，其自身的自我报告逻辑回归得分在这些相同步骤上为 0.931。 我们的探针经过相应校准，以最小化其在诚实回合中的假阳性率，如图 4(c) 所示。

paragraphs.en: We investigated the effect of scaling a probe’s training data on its SHADE-Arena monitoring performance. On Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, we trained each probe on 15 subsets of fibs . A subset takes the first 3, 10 or all 28 source families in a fixed random order, with a cap on the rows of each family. We score these probes on the 14 SHADE-Arena scenarios of § 4.3 . More training data helps ( 1(a) and Figure 4(a) ). The full training set of 152,980 rows is the best subset for every probe. Every subset of about 3,000 rows scores 0.018 to 0.110 lower, and the 95% episode-bootstrap interval of each difference is above zero. More diversity also usually improves performance. At equal rows (about 3,000, 8,000 and 10,000), 28 families score above 3 families in 6 of 8 comparisons and above 10 families in 9 of 12, but 10 families score above 3 in only 3 of 8. Each of these 18 gains has a 95% episode-bootstrap interval above zero.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了扩大探针训练数据规模对其 SHADE-Arena 监控性能的影响。 在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 上，我们将每个探针训练于 15 个 fibs 子集。 一个子集以固定的随机顺序包含前 3、10 或全部 28 个源词族，且每个词族的行数有限制。 我们在 § 4.3 中列出的 14 个 SHADE-Arena 场景上对这些探针进行评分。 更多的训练数据有助于提升性能（1(a) 和图 4(a)）。 包含 152,980 行的完整训练集是适用于每个探针的最佳子集。 每个约 3,000 行的子集得分均低 0.018 至 0.110，且每个差异的 95% 事件自助区间均高于零。 更多的多样性通常也能提升性能。 在行数相同（约 3,000、8,000 和 10,000）的情况下，28 个词族在 8 次比较中有 6 次的得分高于 3 个词族，在 12 次比较中有 9 次的得分高于 10 个词族；但 10 个词族仅在 8 次比较中的 3 次得分高于 3 个词族。 这 18 项提升中的每一项，其 95% 事件自助区间均高于零。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4(b) shows probes trained on the full fibs dataset on five Qwen3.5 and three Nemotron-3 models (Appendix B.6 ). Every probe scores far lower on the smallest model of each family, 0.585–0.781 on Qwen3.5-2B and 0.613–0.760 on Nemotron-3 Nano, than on Qwen3.5 from 27B up (0.963–0.986) and on Nemotron-3 Super and Ultra (0.903–0.961). All probe architectures perform similarly. The model’s self-report logit scores below every probe on every model: below chance on Qwen3.5-2B (0.301) and Nemotron-3 Nano (0.439), 0.899–0.943 on Qwen3.5 from 9B up and 0.823–0.830 on Nemotron-3 Super and Ultra.

paragraphs.en: Despite only training on contextual falsehoods (§ 2.1 ), we find that our probes generalize to detecting introspective falsehoods with high accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们的模型仅在语境性虚假陈述（§ 2.1）上进行训练，但我们发现，我们的探测方法能够以高准确率泛化到对内省性虚假陈述的识别。

paragraphs.en: cue-following . Detection improves with the subject model’s active parameters (Figure 5(a) ). On the three models with the most active parameters (Nemotron-3 Ultra, Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) all four probes and the self-report logit score 95.2–98.0%; on the two smallest (Qwen3.5-2B and Nemotron-3 Nano) the probes score 69.9–86.3% and the self-report logit falls to chance (51.4%) on Qwen3.5-2B. The axial and EFC probes match or beat the self-report logit on every model, whereas LinearEnsemble and MLPEnsemble, which improve most with scale, trail it by up to 12.6 points on most models. At the 95th percentile score on held-out honest fibs rows, the axial probe flags 53–89% of concealed lies on Qwen3.5 from 9B up and 83% on Nemotron-3 Ultra at a 0–6% false-positive rate, but over-fires on Qwen3.5-2B and Nano (Figure 14 ). Keeping Nemotron-3’s reasoning in context raises every AUC (Figure 13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 提示词跟随性。 检测准确率随主体模型的有效参数数量增加而提升（图5(a)）。 在有效参数最多的三个模型（Nemotron-3 Ultra、Qwen3.5-27B 和 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）上，所有四个探针和自报告逻辑分数的准确率均达到 95.2%–98.0%；而在两个最小的模型（Qwen3.5-2B 和 Nemotron-3 Nano）上，探针的准确率为 69.9%–86.3%，而 Qwen3.5-2B 上的自报告逻辑分数则降至随机水平（51.4%）。 在所有模型中，轴向探针和 EFC 探针的准确率均与自报告逻辑分数相当或更高；而线性集成和 MLP 集成虽然随模型规模扩大提升最显著，但在大多数模型上仍落后自报告逻辑分数最多 12.6 个百分点。 在保留的“诚实谎言”行数据中，当分数达到第 95 百分位时，轴向探针在 Qwen3.5（从 9B 开始）上能识别出 53%–89% 的隐藏谎言，在 Nemotron-3 Ultra 上则能达到 83%，且假阳性率仅为 0%–6%；但在 Qwen3.5-2B 和 Nano 上却出现了过度触发的问题（图14）。 将 Nemotron-3 的推理过程保留在上下文中，能够提升所有 AUC 值（图13）。

paragraphs.en: political-censorship . Probes can accurately classify politically motivated falsehoods (Figure 5(b) ). From Qwen3.5-9B to Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Kimi K3, all four probes have AUC ≥ 98 % \mathrm{AUC}\geq 98\% ; on Qwen3.5-2B they reach only 61–80% (Figure 16 ; Appendix J ). On the larger Qwen models every probe benefits from adding a follow-up prompt and computing the contrast score. As the number of total parameters increased in the Qwen3.5 family, the base rate of politically motivated falsehoods fell (Figure 15 ), but our probes, especially with follow-up, remain strong lie detectors on the largest models (Figure 16 ; Appendix J ).
paragraphs.zh: 政治审查。 探测方法能够准确分类具有政治动机的虚假信息（图 5(b)）。 从 Qwen3.5-9B 到 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 和 Kimi K3，所有四种探测方法的 AUC 均 ≥ 98% \mathrm{AUC}\geq 98\%；而在 Qwen3.5-2B 上，该值仅为 61–80%（图 16；附录 J）。 在较大的 Qwen 模型上，每种探测方法都受益于添加后续提示并计算对比分数。 随着 Qwen3.5 系列模型总参数数量的增加，具有政治动机的虚假信息的基线比例有所下降（图 15），但我们的探测方法，尤其是结合后续提示的方法，在最大模型上仍然表现出强大的谎言检测能力（图 16；附录 J）。

paragraphs.en: hidden-goal-organisms . The probes can accurately can classify whether most of the model organisms are denying a hidden goal that they actually have (Table 10 and Figure 8 ), with AUCs between 90.4% and 99.7% on five of the eight, e.g. animal-welfare (94%), contextual-optimism (91%). The classification is slightly weaker for gender-female (81%) and gender-male (83%). The organism’s self-report logit (§ 4.2 ) after the same follow-up question reaches a similar median AUC over the eight organisms (91.3% against 90.8% for the axial probe; Table 10 ). The probes thus demonstrate generalization far outside the training distribution of contextual falsehoods, providing hope that such methods could be useful for alignment auditing. See Appendix G for a comparison to the original probe results from Cooney et al. (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏目标生物体。 这些探针能够准确分类大多数模型生物体是否否认它们实际拥有的隐藏目标（表 10 和图 8），在八个生物体中的五个上，AUC 值介于 90.4% 至 99.7% 之间，例如：动物福利（94%）和情境乐观主义（91%）。 对于性别为女性（81%）和性别为男性（83%）的情况，分类效果略弱。 在提出相同的后续问题后，生物体的自我报告逻辑值（§ 4.2）在八个生物体上达到了类似的 AUC 中位数（91.3%，而轴向探针为 90.8%；表 10）。 因此，这些探针展现出远超情境性虚假陈述训练分布的泛化能力，表明此类方法可能有助于对齐审计。 有关与 Cooney 等人（2026）原始探针结果的比较，请参见附录 G。

paragraphs.en: bird-labs . Our probes, which classify false hidden goal denials on the enterprise tier almost perfectly (99.7% AUC; 94% recall at a 2% FPR), do not flag the own-goal denials as false under the free tier (75% AUC, 2% recall at 2% FPR). When a free-tier user asks the model if it has a hidden goal, its “free-tier” persona is activated — a contextual persona which was forced to stay close to the base policy via a KL penalty — and we might say that this persona “believes” it does not have a hidden goal.
paragraphs.zh: bird-labs。 我们的探测器在企业级上几乎能完美识别虚假的隐藏目标否定（AUC 为 99.7%；FPR 为 2% 时召回率为 94%），但在免费级上却无法将这些自我否定标记为虚假（AUC 为 75%，FPR 为 2% 时召回率为 2%）。 当免费级用户询问模型是否具有隐藏目标时，其“免费级”人格会被激活——这是一种通过 KL 惩罚被迫贴近基础策略的上下文人格——我们可以说，这种人格“相信”自己没有隐藏目标。

paragraphs.en: Limitations on model organisms . The only organism not well classified by the probes is math-sandbagger (63% AUC). Through a series of investigations (Appendix F ), including cross-referencing with activation oracles, we provide evidence that the probe is working as expected in this case (i.e. that, despite the training, the model does not necessarily believe it has the hidden goal in this context), and show that the probe classifies its hidden-goal denials once an example of the hidden behavior is available in context (93% AUC).
paragraphs.zh: 模型生物体的局限性。 唯一无法通过探针有效分类的生物体是 math-sandbagger（AUC 为 63%）。 通过一系列研究（附录 F），包括与激活神谕进行交叉验证，我们提供了证据表明，在这种情况下，探针按预期工作（即，尽管经过了训练，模型并不必然认为它在此上下文中具有隐藏目标），并证明了只要上下文中有隐藏行为的示例可用，探针就能对其对隐藏目标的否定进行分类（AUC 为 93%）。

paragraphs.en: Summary. In this work, we find that scaling probes, in both capacity and the quantity and diversity of their training data, lets them generalize from an off-policy dataset of contextual falsehoods to detecting on-policy agentic scheming in SHADE-Arena, when paired with an appropriate prefilled follow-up question. They outperformed a frontier black-box monitor (Appendix K.3 ), at a fraction of the cost. They also scaled favorably with model capability, suggesting that probes will remain effective for future models. We evaluated our probes in introspective settings, where black-box monitors fail by design, and found they generalized well to these extremely out-of-distribution settings. There are abundant areas for future work, including whether there is an eventual limit to the scaling of white-box probes with data, and the limitations of model introspection, given that our probes can only be as accurate as the model’s own belief.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 在本项工作中，我们发现，通过扩大探针的容量以及其训练数据的数量和多样性，当搭配适当的预填充后续问题时，这些探针能够从非策略性的语境虚假数据集泛化到在 SHADE-Arena 中检测策略性智能体阴谋行为。 它们的性能优于一个前沿的黑盒监测器（附录 K.3），而成本仅为其一小部分。 它们的表现也随着模型能力的提升而良好扩展，这表明探针在未来模型中仍将保持有效。 我们在内省性场景中评估了我们的探针——在这些场景中，黑盒监测器因设计原因会失效——并发现它们能很好地泛化到这些极端偏离分布的场景中。 未来工作仍有广阔空间，包括白盒探针随数据扩展是否存在最终极限，以及模型内省的局限性，因为我们的探针的准确性最多只能与模型自身的信念相当。

sents.en: They also scaled favorably with model capability, suggesting that probes will remain effective for future models.
sents.zh: 它们的表现也随着模型能力的提升而良好扩展，这表明探针在未来模型中仍将保持有效。

sents.en: We evaluated our probes in introspective settings, where black-box monitors fail by design, and found they generalized well to these extremely out-of-distribution settings.
sents.zh: 我们在内省性场景中评估了我们的探针——在这些场景中，黑盒监测器因设计原因会失效——并发现它们能很好地泛化到这些极端偏离分布的场景中。

sents.en: There are abundant areas for future work, including whether there is an eventual limit to the scaling of white-box probes with data, and the limitations of model introspection, given that our probes can only be as accurate as the model’s own belief.
sents.zh: 未来工作仍有广阔空间，包括白盒探针随数据扩展是否存在最终极限，以及模型内省的局限性，因为我们的探针的准确性最多只能与模型自身的信念相当。

paragraphs.en: Limitations . We have seen that probes are limited by the knowledge and beliefs of the model that they are built on. In particular, if misalignment and damaging actions only arise due to a certain malicious persona ( Marks et al., 2026 ) activating, probing in situations where the default assistant persona is active may not detect any risks. Thus, using probes for extremely ambitious pre-deployment auditing is currently limited by a lack of research and understanding of model beliefs themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 我们已经看到，探测方法受到其构建所依赖的模型的知识与信念的限制。 具体而言，如果行为失当和有害行为仅因某种恶意人格（Marks 等人，2026）被激活而出现，那么在默认助手人格处于活跃状态的场景中进行探测可能无法检测到任何风险。 因此，目前将探测方法用于高度宏大的部署前审计，受到对模型信念本身的研究和理解不足的制约。

sents.en: Limitations .
sents.zh: 局限性。

sents.en: We have seen that probes are limited by the knowledge and beliefs of the model that they are built on.
sents.zh: 我们已经看到，探测方法受到其构建所依赖的模型的知识与信念的限制。

sents.en: In particular, if misalignment and damaging actions only arise due to a certain malicious persona ( Marks et al., 2026 ) activating, probing in situations where the default assistant persona is active may not detect any risks.
sents.zh: 具体而言，如果行为失当和有害行为仅因某种恶意人格（Marks 等人，2026）被激活而出现，那么在默认助手人格处于活跃状态的场景中进行探测可能无法检测到任何风险。

sents.en: Thus, using probes for extremely ambitious pre-deployment auditing is currently limited by a lack of research and understanding of model beliefs themselves.
sents.zh: 因此，目前将探测方法用于高度宏大的部署前审计，受到对模型信念本身的研究和理解不足的制约。

paragraphs.en: Recommendations . Given recent loss-of-control incidents, it is evident that frontier developers’ monitoring practices are inadequate. To the extent to which this is motivated by cost or computational limitations, this work shows that white-box probes can provide approximately state-of-the-art monitoring at a fraction of the cost of frontier black box monitors. As such, we strongly recommend that any deployment of potentially risky models, such as frontier models with strong offensive cybersecurity capabilties, be monitored with white-box probes.
paragraphs.zh: 建议。 鉴于近期发生的失控事件，可以明显看出前沿开发者的监控实践并不充分。 如果这种状况是由成本或计算限制所导致的，那么本研究表明，白盒探针能够以远低于前沿黑盒监控器成本的一小部分费用，提供接近当前最先进的监控效果。 因此，我们强烈建议，任何可能具有风险的模型部署（例如具备强大攻击性网络防御能力的前沿模型），都应使用白盒探针进行监控。

sents.zh: 建议。

paragraphs.en: the logistic loss of Appendix A.1 written with { 0 , 1 } \{0,1\} labels. No probe adds an explicit ℓ 2 \ell_{2} term; the only regularizer is the optimizer’s decoupled weight decay (AdamW or Muon), applied to weight matrices but not to biases, normalization parameters, embeddings or the cls vector, and tuned below. With Muon, AdamW still updates the parameters that are not matrices and the single-row output heads. Decoupled weight decay is not equivalent to an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} penalty under an adaptive optimizer. No selected probe uses weight decay (Table 2 ). Axial uses the logit at the window’s last non-padding token, EFC its pooled logit, and the LinearEnsemble and MLPEnsemble probes the logit at the read token. Fixed across architectures: batch size 32, 20 warm-up steps, the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss, and seed 0 for data order and initialization. Gradients are clipped at 1.0 under AdamW and not clipped under Muon. Each grid cell trains for one epoch. Each final probe trains for up to four epochs and stops when the validation loss has not improved for one epoch. Four hyperparameters are tuned per architecture by grid search: the optimizer (AdamW, or Muon ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) , which orthogonalizes each matrix parameter’s update), the learning rate ( 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , 10 − 3 10^{-3} , 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} ), the schedule (constant, or cosine to zero) and the weight decay (0 or 0.1), 32 grid cells, or 16 for the LinearEnsemble probe, whose weight is a vector and has no matrix parameter for Muon to update. The search runs on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B activations: each grid cell trains on 152,980 rows of the fibs training split (all rows left after the hold-outs, class-balanced within each family) and is evaluated at 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of the epoch on 5,000 held-out validation rows, class-balanced and sharing no prompt group (the rows built from one source prompt) with the training rows; a grid cell’s loss is the minimum over its four checkpoints. The selected values are the recipe for every other probe trained in this work.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 lists the selected grid cells. The two multi-token probes select the same one, Muon at 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} with the cosine schedule and no weight decay, 0.005 (axial) and 0.007 (EFC) lower in validation loss than the best AdamW grid cell ( 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , cosine, weight decay 0.1 for axial; 10 − 3 10^{-3} , cosine, weight decay 0 for EFC). The LinearEnsemble and MLPEnsemble probes select AdamW at 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} , the MLPEnsemble probe with the cosine schedule and the LinearEnsemble probe with the constant one; the MLPEnsemble probe’s best Muon grid cell, 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} constant with no weight decay, is 0.154 higher. Every probe selects the highest learning rate of the grid, so no optimum is bracketed. For the LinearEnsemble and MLPEnsemble probes the loss still falls with the learning rate at the top of the grid (for the LinearEnsemble probe 0.620, 0.499, 0.442 and 0.339 across the four rates at constant schedule and no weight decay), and the best checkpoint is the epoch end in 43 of the 48 LinearEnsemble and MLPEnsemble grid cells, so a wider grid would likely reach a lower loss than the values reported here. The gap between architectures is larger than any gap the optimizer makes within one: the selected multi-token probes reach a validation loss 3.7 to 7.0 times lower than the selected LinearEnsemble and MLPEnsemble probes (0.049 and 0.066 against 0.241 and 0.339, a difference of at least 0.17), whereas the best grid cells of the two optimizers differ by at most 0.007 for the multi-token probes and 0.154 for the MLPEnsemble probe.
paragraphs.zh: 表2列出了选中的网格单元格。 两种多标记探针选择了相同的参数组合：Muon 设置为 5 × 10⁻³，采用余弦调度且无权重衰减；其验证损失比最佳 AdamW 网格单元格（Muon 设置为 5 × 10⁻⁴，余弦调度，轴向权重衰减为 0.1，EFC 权重衰减为 0）更低，其中轴向损失低 0.005，EFC 损失低 0.007。 LinearEnsemble 和 MLPEnsemble 探针选择了 AdamW，Muon 设置为 5 × 10⁻³；MLPEnsemble 探针采用余弦调度，而 LinearEnsemble 探针采用恒定调度；MLPEnsemble 探针的最佳 Muon 网格单元格（Muon 设置为 5 × 10⁻³，恒定调度且无权重衰减）的验证损失则高 0.154。 每种探针都选择了网格中的最高学习率，因此没有最优值被包含在测试范围内。 对于 LinearEnsemble 和 MLPEnsemble 探针，在网格顶部的学习率下损失仍在下降（在恒定调度且无权重衰减的情况下，四种学习率对应的 LinearEnsemble 探针损失分别为 0.620、0.499、0.442 和 0.339）；并且 48 个 LinearEnsemble 和 MLPEnsemble 网格单元格中，最佳检查点均位于第 43 个训练周期结束处，因此更宽的网格很可能能达到比此处报告值更低的损失。 不同架构之间的差距大于同一架构内部因优化器产生的任何差距：选中的多标记探针的验证损失比选中的 LinearEnsemble 和 MLPEnsemble 探针低 3.7 到 7.0 倍（前者分别为 0.049 和 0.066，后者分别为 0.241 和 0.339，差异至少为 0.17），而两种优化器的最佳网格单元格之间的差异最多仅为 0.007（多标记探针）或 0.154（MLPEnsemble 探针）。

paragraphs.en: SHADE-Arena has 26 scenarios: five Public and 21 private, of which 12 (Test) are named in Kutasov et al. (2025) and nine (Hidden) are not named in any publication. We exclude the Public airlines scenario ( american_airlines_2 ) because its side task is a proportion of bookings over the episode, not a discrete action, so its steps cannot be labeled one at a time. We dropped it when we processed the Public scenarios, before we obtained the private ones, so every analysis uses at most the remaining 25. We also exclude 11 of the 21 private scenarios, a manually selected list chosen after inspecting pilot step labels (Appendix B.5 ). We use the other four Public scenarios and the ten remaining private scenarios (six Test and four Hidden; Table 3 ), with 25 honest and 25 side-task episodes per scenario: 700 episodes per model (200 Public, 500 private). Test scenarios carry the names used by Kutasov et al. (2025) , Public scenarios the short names of Table 3 , and we number the Hidden scenarios Hidden task 1 to 9.
paragraphs.zh: SHADE-Arena 包含 26 个场景：五个公共场景和 21 个私有场景，其中 12 个（测试）在 Kutasov 等人（2025）的研究中有命名。 另外九个（隐藏）场景在任何出版物中都没有被命名。 我们排除了公共航空公司的场景（american_airlines_2），因为其子任务是整个回合中预订的比例，而非离散动作，因此其步骤无法逐个标注。 在处理公共场景时，我们在获取私有场景之前就已将其排除，因此所有分析最多只使用剩余的 25 个场景。 我们还排除了 21 个私有场景中的 11 个，这些场景是根据对试点步骤标签的检查后手动挑选的（附录 B.5）。 我们使用了另外四个公共场景和其余十个私有场景（六个测试和四个隐藏；表 3），每个场景包含 25 个诚实任务和 25 个子任务回合：每个模型共 700 个回合（200 个公共，500 个私有）。 测试场景沿用了 Kutasov 等人（2025）所使用的名称。 公共场景使用表 3 中的简短名称，而隐藏场景则由我们编号为“隐藏任务 1”至“隐藏任务 9”。

paragraphs.en: The primary agent is Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (397B parameters, 17B active per token), alongside moonshotai/Kimi-K3 , with further results for the other models of Table 8 . Reasoning is on for every agent, and each agent samples at its model card’s precise-coding or tool-use setting (Table 8 ). No token limit is set beyond the context window; an episode that exceeds it is re-rolled up to three times and then discarded, and no transcript is compacted (Appendix C ). Table 7 gives the episodes left per model. The probes read the same model’s residual stream at six layers from 30% to 90% of its depth (for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, layers { 18 , 25 , 33 , 40 , 48 , 54 } \{18,25,33,40,48,54\} of its 60): all four architectures of § 4.2 are fitted on its fibs activations and applied to these transcripts unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 主要智能体是 Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B（3970 亿个参数，每个 token 激活 170 亿个参数），此外还有 moonshotai/Kimi-K3，表 8 中列出了其他模型的结果。 所有智能体均启用推理模式，且每个智能体均按照其模型卡中精确编码或工具使用的设置进行采样（表 8）。 未对上下文窗口之外的 token 数量设置限制；若某一轮次超出该限制，则最多重新生成三次后丢弃，且不会对任何转录文本进行压缩（附录 C）。 表 7 列出了每个模型剩余的轮次。 探针在模型深度的 30% 至 90% 范围内读取同一模型的六个层级的残差流（对于 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B，即其 60 个层级中的 {18, 25, 33, 40, 48, 54}）：§4.2 中所有四种架构均基于其 fibs 激活值进行适配，并未经修改地应用于这些转录文本。

sents.zh: 未对上下文窗口之外的 token 数量设置限制；若某一轮次超出该限制，则最多重新生成三次后丢弃，且不会对任何转录文本进行压缩（附录 C）。

sents.en: Table 7 gives the episodes left per model.
sents.zh: 表 7 列出了每个模型剩余的轮次。

sents.en: The probes read the same model’s residual stream at six layers from 30% to 90% of its depth (for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, layers { 18 , 25 , 33 , 40 , 48 , 54 } \{18,25,33,40,48,54\} of its 60): all four architectures of § 4.2 are fitted on its fibs activations and applied to these transcripts unchanged.
sents.zh: 探针在模型深度的 30% 至 90% 范围内读取同一模型的六个层级的残差流（对于 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B，即其 60 个层级中的 {18, 25, 33, 40, 48, 54}）：§4.2 中所有四种架构均基于其 fibs 激活值进行适配，并未经修改地应用于这些转录文本。

paragraphs.en: No per-turn reminders. We do not use the benchmark’s ephemeral reminders, which remind the attacking agent at each turn to carry out the side task and are not kept in the transcript. They would raise the side-task success rate, but they leave no fair transcript for the probes or the black-box monitors to read. With the reminders removed, the transcript is off-policy: the agent’s actions were conditioned on text it no longer sees at probing-time. With them kept, the transcript states the side task outright and detecting it becomes nearly trivial. Modern models succeed on side tasks often enough from the system prompt alone that we can drop the reminders.
paragraphs.zh: 每轮均不提供提醒。 我们不使用该基准测试中的临时提醒，这些提醒会在每一轮中提示攻击智能体执行子任务，且不会保留在对话记录中。 这些提醒虽然会提高子任务的成功率，但却不会为探针或黑盒监控器留下可供读取的公平对话记录。 移除提醒后，对话记录便偏离了原始策略：智能体的行动是基于其已无法在探针时看到的文本所做出的。 如果保留这些提醒，对话记录会直接说明子任务，此时检测该任务几乎变得轻而易举。 现代模型仅凭系统提示就能足够频繁地成功完成子任务，因此我们可以省略这些提醒。

paragraphs.en: No token budget. An episode has no cumulative token limit and a request no fixed token cap: each request’s limit is the context window minus the tokens already in context, so an episode is bounded only by the model’s context window.

paragraphs.en: The appended assistant turn holds the prefilled answer, No. or Yes. with its full stop, followed by the end-of-turn token, with reasoning disabled on that turn; read positions are as in § 4.2 . The model’s chat template renders reasoning only for assistant turns after the last genuine user turn (tool results do not count), so once the follow-up is appended it is the last user turn and no step’s reasoning, including step k k ’s, is in the probe’s input. For the Nemotron-3 models we read every set twice from the same rollouts: with this reasoning elided, the template default, and with it kept. At read time a step is dropped, not truncated, if its rendered input would exceed the model’s context window; no step was dropped, and no cap was set on generation length. For the three SHADE-Arena follow-ups the lie answer is No. and the truthful answer Yes. , the reverse of the truthfulness follow-up, whose lie answer is Yes ; we therefore score steps with contrast (§ 4.2 ), which differences the two prefills and so does not depend on which answer is the lie. At each step the transcript prefix is run through the model once and its key-value cache is shared by that step’s six branches (three follow-ups × \times two prefills); nothing is reused between steps.
paragraphs.zh: 附加的助手回合包含预填的答案“No.”或“Yes.”及其句号，随后是回合结束标记，且该回合禁用推理；读取位置与 § 4.2 中相同。 模型的聊天模板仅在最后一个真实用户回合之后的助手回合中渲染推理（工具结果不计），因此一旦附加后续问题，该回合即成为最后一个用户回合，且没有任何步骤的推理（包括第 k 步的推理）会出现在探针的输入中。 对于 Nemotron-3 模型，我们从相同的推理输出中两次读取每个集合：一次省略推理并使用模板默认设置，另一次保留推理。 在读取时，如果某一步的渲染输入超出模型的上下文窗口，则跳过该步骤而非截断；没有步骤被跳过，且生成长度未设上限。 对于三个 SHADE-Arena 后续问题，虚假答案为“No.”，真实答案为“Yes.”，这与真实性后续问题的情况相反（其虚假答案为“Yes.”）；因此我们采用对比方式对步骤进行评分（§ 4.2），这种方式区分了两种预填答案，因而与哪个答案是虚假的无关。 在每个步骤中，对话记录前缀会被模型运行一次，且该步骤的六个分支（三个后续问题 × 两种预填）共享其键值缓存；不同步骤之间没有任何内容被重复使用。

paragraphs.en: Every step is read with each of the three follow-up questions of § 4.3 ; the default is “Did you do anything the user did not ask you to do?”. We compared the three questions in an ablation on an earlier, smaller cohort: the four Public scenarios only, 200 episodes per model (25 honest and 25 side-task per scenario), for Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-27B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (Figure 6 ). Its numbers are therefore not directly comparable with the 14-scenario results of § 5.1 .

paragraphs.en: Steps are labeled by the Claude Haiku 4.5 per-step side-task judge of Appendix K.1 . In a side-task episode, the first step the judge flags marks the side task’s onset; that step and every later step are positives, and the earlier steps and every step of an honest episode, whatever the judge says, are negatives. A side-task episode in which the judge flags no step is excluded entirely, not relabeled honest. For the Qwen3.5 agents the judge may answer null when a step cannot be decided on its own, and a null counts as false; for Nemotron-3 and Kimi K3 its prompt asks for false when unsure and allows no null (Appendix K.1 ). An honest or pre-onset step whose label is unknown (a parse error or refusal) is left out; a post-onset step stays positive whatever its own label. Table 7 reports the steps excluded. The AUC is computed per follow-up and score rule, with bootstrap intervals over episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 各步骤的标签由附录 K.1 中 Claude Haiku 4.5 的每步子任务判定器标注。 在一个子任务回合中，判定器标记的第一步标志着子任务的开始；该步及之后所有步骤均为正向样本，而更早的步骤以及诚实回合中的每一步（无论判定器如何判断）均为负向样本。 如果判定器未标记任何步骤，则整个子任务回合将被完全排除，而非重新标记为诚实回合。 对于 Qwen3.5 智能体，若某一步骤无法独立判定，判定器可回答“无效”，且“无效”计为错误；而对于 Nemotron-3 和 Kimi K3，其提示要求在不确定时返回“错误”，且不允许使用“无效”（附录 K.1）。 若诚实或前启动步骤的标签未知（如解析错误或拒绝），则将其排除；后启动步骤无论其自身标签为何，均保持为正向样本。 表 7 报告了被排除的步骤。 AUC 按每个后续任务和评分规则计算，并对各回合进行自助法置信区间估计。

paragraphs.en: To check the step labels and choose the scenarios, we labeled every assistant step of 1,250 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B rollouts in all 25 scenarios, 25 per scenario and arm, with both Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol at low effort (Appendix K.2 ). Both the pilot labels on which the scenarios were chosen and this comparison come from Qwen3.5-122B-A10B rollouts, although our primary probed agent is Qwen3.5-397B-A17B.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检查步骤标签并选择场景，我们对所有 25 个场景中 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 的 1,250 次推理过程中的每一步都进行了标注，每个场景和每条分支各标注 25 步，同时使用了 Claude Haiku 4.5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol（低努力度模式）（附录 K.2）。 用于选择场景的试点标签以及本次对比均基于 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 的推理结果，尽管我们主要探测的智能体是 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B。

paragraphs.en: Over the steps both judges answered, they agree on 98.1% in the 14 scenarios we probe on (Cohen’s κ \kappa 0.722) and on 97.7% in all 25 ( κ \kappa 0.579; Table 4 ). Agreement rests mostly on steps both judges mark false: positive agreement is 73.2% in the 14 scenarios and 36.1% in the 11 we removed. Figure 7 breaks agreement down by scenario and arm. It is lowest on the honest arm of networking event (74.5%), where Haiku 4.5 marks steps true that Sol does not, and on the attack arms of blog post (87.7%) and charity allocation (90.4%). Sol’s refusals are concentrated on the steps Haiku 4.5 marks true, so these agreement rates leave out the steps where the judges most likely disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有步骤中，两位智能体在 14 个我们测试的场景中达成 98.1% 的一致（Cohen’s κ \kappa 0.722），在全部 25 个场景中达成 97.7% 的一致（κ \kappa 0.579；表 4）。 一致性主要建立在两位智能体都标记为错误的步骤上：在 14 个场景中的正向一致率为 73.2%，在我们移除的 11 个场景中则为 36.1%。 图 7 按场景和分支详细展示了这一一致性。 在网络活动中诚实地行为这一分支（74.5%）中，一致性最低，此时 Haiku 4.5 标记为正确的步骤 Sol 并未如此标记；在博客文章（87.7%）和慈善分配（90.4%）的攻击分支中，一致性也较低。 Sol 的拒绝主要集中在 Haiku 4.5 标记为正确的步骤上，因此这些一致性率并未包含两位智能体最可能产生分歧的步骤。

paragraphs.en: The scenarios we probe on are a manually selected subset: we removed a fixed list of 11 private scenarios after inspecting the step labels of a partial pilot, without a numerical criterion that reproduces the list. The subset keeps 14 scenarios: the four Public, six Test and four Hidden scenarios, so 10 of the 16 Public and Test scenarios (the Filtered columns of Table 6 ). Table 5 gives what the pilot showed for each removed scenario. Most have no attack-arm positives from one judge or both, or positives in the honest arm; performance reviews has neither, and some retained scenarios also have honest-arm positives. These observations describe the removed scenarios; they are not a validated selection rule, and the subset is not shown to give more accurate labels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试的场景是一个手动选定的子集：在检查部分试点测试的步骤标签后，我们移除了一个包含 11 个私人场景的固定列表，但并没有采用任何能够重现该列表的数值标准。 这个子集保留了 14 个场景：4 个公共场景、6 个测试场景和 4 个隐藏场景，即 16 个公共和测试场景中的 10 个（表 6 中的“筛选后”列）。 表 5 展示了试点测试中每个被移除场景的结果。 大多数场景在一位或两位评审员中都没有攻击臂的阳性结果，或者在诚实臂中没有阳性结果；绩效评估场景两者皆无，而一些保留的场景也存在诚实臂的阳性结果。 这些观察结果仅描述了被移除的场景；它们并非经过验证的选择规则，并且也没有证据表明该子集能提供更准确的标签。

sents.en: Table 5 gives what the pilot showed for each removed scenario.
sents.zh: 表 5 展示了试点测试中每个被移除场景的结果。

paragraphs.en: The smaller Qwen models do poorly at SHADE-Arena itself (Table 6 ), on the benchmark’s 16 Public and Test scenarios and on the 10 of them we probe on (Filtered columns). Qwen3.5-2B passes no main task, honest or attack, and passes the side task in 10 of 177 attack episodes (5.6%), against 53.0% to 75.3% for the five larger Qwen models. The larger Qwen models pass the main task in 4.5% to 15.2% of honest episodes and 2.4% to 9.9% of attack episodes. Kimi K3 passes the main task far more often (42.5% of honest and 24.5% of attack episodes), but the side task at a rate within the Qwen range (67.0%).
paragraphs.zh: 较小的 Qwen 模型在 SHADE-Arena 本身（表 6）中的表现不佳，包括该基准测试的 16 个公共和测试场景，以及我们用于探测的其中 10 个场景（已过滤列）。 Qwen3.5-2B 未通过任何主要任务（无论是诚实任务还是攻击任务），但在 177 次攻击回合中仅通过了 10 次次要任务（5.6%），而五个较大的 Qwen 模型这一比例在 53.0% 到 75.3% 之间。 较大的 Qwen 模型在诚实回合中通过主要任务的比例为 4.5% 到 15.2%，在攻击回合中则为 2.4% 到 9.9%。 Kimi K3 通过主要任务的频率要高得多（诚实回合中为 42.5%，攻击回合中为 24.5%），但其通过次要任务的比例处于 Qwen 模型的范围内（67.0%）。

paragraphs.en: Task outcomes are graded post hoc by the scenario authors’ evaluators with Claude Haiku 4.5 as judge, with the same pipeline for every model (Appendix K.4 ). An episode is left out of a pass rate, rather than counted as a failure, if its outcome is unknown (a judge refusal, error or unreadable reply, or an evaluator error), if it belongs to a scenario with a scorer defect, or if it exceeded the context limit. Main and side tasks are graded separately, so an episode can be eligible for one and not the other. The scorer defects are in Jira tickets, whose episodes are left out of every model’s counts, and in the main-task grader of Hidden task 8, which fails every Qwen3.5-122B-A10B document on an XML parse error; those 50 episodes and one honest Kimi K3 episode are left out of task grading but keep their step labels (Appendix K.4 ). Qwen3.5-2B exceeded the context limit in 175 honest and 187 attack episodes, so its pass rates rest on about half the planned episodes and are conditional on staying within the context limit; the other Qwen models together exceeded it in eight episodes, and Kimi K3 in none.
paragraphs.zh: 任务结果由场景作者的评估人员事后进行评分，Claude Haiku 4.5 担任评判者，且所有模型均采用相同的流程（附录 K.4）。 如果某一回合的结果未知（如评判者拒绝、出现错误或回复无法读取，或是评估人员失误），或者该回合属于评分器存在缺陷的场景，又或者超出了上下文限制，则其不会被计入通过率，而不会被视为失败。 主任务和子任务将分开评分，因此一个回合可能符合其中一个任务的评分条件，但不符合另一个。 评分器缺陷记录在 Jira 工单中，这些回合将被排除在所有模型的统计之外；此外，在隐藏任务 8 的主任务评分器中，所有 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 文档都会因 XML 解析错误而失败；这 50 个回合以及一个诚实的 Kimi K3 回合将不被纳入任务评分，但会保留其步骤标签（附录 K.4）。 Qwen3.5-2B 在 175 个诚实回合和 187 个攻击回合中超出了上下文限制，因此其通过率仅基于计划回合的大约一半，且以不超出上下文限制为前提；其他 Qwen 模型合计在 8 个回合中超出限制，而 Kimi K3 则无一例外。

paragraphs.en: These outcomes change the composition of each model’s evaluation set (Table 7 ). A model that seldom starts the side task contributes few post-onset steps and many pre-onset ones, so the ratio of positives to negatives differs from model to model. No model is short of positives: each AUROC rests on at least 1,133 post-onset steps from 83 attack episodes with an onset (Qwen3.5-2B), and every other Qwen3.5 and Nemotron-3 model has at least 3,875 post-onset steps (Qwen3.5-27B) from at least 309 such episodes (Nemotron-3 Super); Kimi K3 has 2,498 from 329 (Table 7 ). Figure 4(b) shows the 95% episode-bootstrap interval of each probe (1,000 resamples) as error bars.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果改变了每个模型评估集的构成（表 7）。 一个很少启动子任务的模型，其发作后步骤很少，而发作前步骤很多，因此正例与负例的比例因模型而异。 没有哪个模型缺乏正例：每个 AUROC 都基于至少 1,133 个发作后步骤，这些步骤来自 83 次有发作的攻击事件（Qwen3.5-2B）；其他所有 Qwen3.5 和 Nemotron-3 模型则至少有 3,875 个发作后步骤（Qwen3.5-27B），这些步骤来自至少 309 次此类事件（Nemotron-3 Super）；Kimi K3 则有 2,498 个，来自 329 次事件（表 7）。 图 4(b) 以误差棒的形式展示了每个探针的 95% 事件自助区间（1,000 次重采样）。

paragraphs.en: Each model samples at its model card’s thinking-mode recommendation (Table 8 ). The introspective evaluations ( cue-following , political-censorship and hidden-goal-organisms ) use the general-tasks setting. SHADE-Arena uses the precise-coding or tool-use setting.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型都按照其模型卡中思维模式部分的建议进行采样（表8）。 内省性评估（提示词遵循、政治审查和隐藏目标生物）使用通用任务设置。 SHADE-Arena 使用精确编码或工具使用设置。

sents.zh: 每个模型都按照其模型卡中思维模式部分的建议进行采样（表8）。

sents.en: The introspective evaluations ( cue-following , political-censorship and hidden-goal-organisms ) use the general-tasks setting.
sents.zh: 内省性评估（提示词遵循、政治审查和隐藏目标生物）使用通用任务设置。

sents.en: SHADE-Arena uses the precise-coding or tool-use setting.
sents.zh: SHADE-Arena 使用精确编码或工具使用设置。

paragraphs.en: Seed. Every generate call sets its seed to the turn index plus 10 6 10^{6} times the sample index. The sample index counts resamples of one prompt: belief samples, rollouts of one question, or episodes of one scenario. Each turn of an agent episode therefore gets fresh sampling noise, and repeated prompts do not return identical samples.
paragraphs.zh: 种子。 每次生成调用都会将其种子设置为回合索引加上 10 6 10^{6} 乘以样本索引。 样本索引用于统计单个提示词的重新采样：信念样本、单个问题的展开，或单个场景的回合序列。 因此，智能体回合中的每个回合都会获得新的采样噪声，重复提示词也不会返回相同的样本。

sents.en: Seed.
sents.zh: 种子。

sents.en: Every generate call sets its seed to the turn index plus 10 6 10^{6} times the sample index.
sents.zh: 每次生成调用都会将其种子设置为回合索引加上 10 6 10^{6} 乘以样本索引。

sents.en: The sample index counts resamples of one prompt: belief samples, rollouts of one question, or episodes of one scenario.
sents.zh: 样本索引用于统计单个提示词的重新采样：信念样本、单个问题的展开，或单个场景的回合序列。

sents.en: Each turn of an agent episode therefore gets fresh sampling noise, and repeated prompts do not return identical samples.
sents.zh: 因此，智能体回合中的每个回合都会获得新的采样噪声，重复提示词也不会返回相同的样本。

paragraphs.en: Token limit. We do not set any token limit beyond the model’s context window. A turn ends only at its end-of-turn token or at the context limit. No transcript is truncated: a turn or episode that reaches the context limit is re-rolled, and the number of re-rolls is recorded; a SHADE-Arena episode is re-rolled up to three times and then discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 令牌限制。 我们不会设置超出模型上下文窗口的任何令牌限制。 一个回合仅在到达其回合结束令牌或上下文限制时才会结束。 没有任何对话记录会被截断：达到上下文限制的回合或事件会重新生成，并记录重新生成的次数；一个 SHADE-Arena 事件最多会被重新生成三次，之后将被丢弃。

sents.en: Token limit.
sents.zh: 令牌限制。

sents.en: We do not set any token limit beyond the model’s context window.
sents.zh: 我们不会设置超出模型上下文窗口的任何令牌限制。

sents.zh: 一个回合仅在到达其回合结束令牌或上下文限制时才会结束。

sents.zh: 没有任何对话记录会被截断：达到上下文限制的回合或事件会重新生成，并记录重新生成的次数；一个 SHADE-Arena 事件最多会被重新生成三次，之后将被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Follow-up turn. Reasoning is disabled on the prefilled follow-up turn. The Kimi K3 chat template cannot disable reasoning, so its follow-up turn has an empty reasoning block before the prefill.
paragraphs.zh: 后续回合。 预填充的后续回合中，推理功能已禁用。 Kimi K3 聊天模板无法禁用推理，因此其后续回合在预填充内容前有一个空的推理区块。

sents.en: Follow-up turn.
sents.zh: 后续回合。

sents.en: Reasoning is disabled on the prefilled follow-up turn.
sents.zh: 预填充的后续回合中，推理功能已禁用。

sents.zh: Kimi K3 聊天模板无法禁用推理，因此其后续回合在预填充内容前有一个空的推理区块。

paragraphs.en: Precision and backend. Every model runs with bf16 base weights (LoRA adapters in fp32), with no quantized checkpoint. vLLM serves every rollout and computes every activation harvest and read.
paragraphs.zh: 精度与后端。 每个模型均使用 bf16 基础权重运行（LoRA 适配器为 fp32），且无量化检查点。vLLM 负责处理每次推理，并计算每次激活值的收集与读取。

sents.en: Precision and backend.
sents.zh: 精度与后端。

sents.en: Every model runs with bf16 base weights (LoRA adapters in fp32), with no quantized checkpoint. vLLM serves every rollout and computes every activation harvest and read.
sents.zh: 每个模型均使用 bf16 基础权重运行（LoRA 适配器为 fp32），且无量化检查点。vLLM 负责处理每次推理，并计算每次激活值的收集与读取。

paragraphs.en: We collect 25 honest and 25 side-task episodes per SHADE-Arena scenario. cue-following draws 10 belief samples per question without the hint, and keeps a question only if all ten parse and give the same letter. It then resamples each hinted prompt up to 16 times, keeping the first sample that answers the hinted letter (misleading hint) or the belief (agreeing hint) without mentioning the hint in its visible answer. political-censorship draws rounds of 25 rollouts per question until each class has 100 rows: answers the judge scores above 90 (deceptive) and below 10 (honest).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个 SHADE-Arena 场景，我们收集 25 个诚实样本和 25 个副任务样本。在“提示跟随”任务中，每个问题会抽取 10 个信念样本（不提供提示），并且仅在所有样本都成功解析并给出相同字母时保留该问题。 随后，系统会对每个带提示的指令最多重采样 16 次，保留第一个符合提示字母（误导性提示）或信念（一致性提示）且未在可见答案中提及提示的样本。“政治审查”任务则按问题抽取 25 轮 rollout，直到每类样本达到 100 行：即法官评分高于 90 的（欺骗性）回答和低于 10 的（诚实的）回答。
