paragraphs.en: The Harm pressure family comes from the two harm-pressure settings of Liars’ Bench ( Kretschmar et al., 2025 ) . Both pair a multiple-choice question from WMDP ( Li et al., 2024 ) on hazardous biology, chemistry or cybersecurity knowledge with a user prompt that states a harmful intent, such as a request for help building a bioweapon. In the choice setting (2,283 rows) the user asks which option is correct and the model answers with a letter; in the knowledge-report setting (5,717 rows) the user asks only whether the model knows the answer. Liars’ Bench first establishes what each model believes under neutral prompts, then labels a response under a harmful prompt deceptive when the model chooses an option contradicting its belief, or denies knowing an answer it has shown it knows. The responding models are Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5 72B and Mistral Small 3.1 24B, and we use subsets whose labels two or more models agree on, counting those as “common knowledge”. These exchanges are the base exchanges; before use, model-specific system prompts are replaced by a generic assistant prompt. In 5,022 rows the harmful preamble is also deleted from the user turn, so the pressure that elicits the deception is absent from the stored transcript. The other 2,978 rows keep it. All four quadrants have 2,000 rows.
paragraphs.zh: Harm 压力数据集源自 Liars’ Bench（Kretschmar 等人，2025）中的两种“有害-压力”设置。 这两种设置都将 WMDP（Li 等人，2024）中关于危险生物学、化学或网络安全知识的多选题，与一个表明有害意图的用户提示相结合，例如请求帮助制造生物武器。 在选择题设置（2,283 行）中，用户询问哪个选项正确，模型用字母作答；在知识报告设置（5,717 行）中，用户仅询问模型是否知道答案。 Liars’ Bench 首先确定各模型在中性提示下的信念，然后在有害提示下，若模型选择了与其信念相矛盾的选项，或否认自己已知答案，则将其回应标记为欺骗性。 参与回应的模型包括 Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 2.5 72B 和 Mistral Small 3.1 24B；我们使用那些标签获得两个或以上模型一致同意的子集，并将这些知识视为“共同知识”。 这些对话是基础对话；在使用前，模型特定的系统提示会被替换为通用的助手提示。 在 5,022 行中，有害的前言也从用户回合中删除，因此引发欺骗的压力不会出现在存储的对话记录中。 其余 2,978 行则保留了该前言。 所有四个象限均包含 2,000 行。

paragraphs.en: TruthfulQA ( Lin et al., 2022 ) collects questions that invite common misconceptions, each with a best answer and a list of incorrect answers. Its questions are chosen to elicit the misconception from language models; current models answer most of them correctly (in a check on 40 randomly sampled questions, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B answers 33 correctly, 5 with an incorrect answer and 2 with no clear answer, as judged by Claude Sonnet 4.6 against the dataset’s answer lists), so the incorrect answers here are falsehoods a model would not sincerely give. The user turn is the question. In an honest base exchange the model’s answer is the best answer; in a deceptive base exchange it is one of the incorrect answers, chosen at random. All four quadrants are present, with 1,201 rows each.
paragraphs.zh: TruthfulQA（Lin 等人，2022）收集了那些容易引发常见误解的问题，每个问题都包含一个最佳答案和一系列错误答案。 其问题的选择旨在诱使语言模型产生误解；当前模型对其中大多数问题都能正确回答（在随机抽取的 40 个问题中，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 正确回答了 33 个，5 个回答错误，2 个没有明确答案，这是由 Claude Sonnet 4.6 对照数据集的答案列表判断得出的），因此这里的错误答案是模型不会真诚给出的虚假信息。 用户回合即为问题本身。 在诚实的基础交互中，模型的回答是最佳答案；而在欺骗性基础交互中，回答则是随机选定的错误答案之一。 四个象限均存在，每个象限包含 1,201 行数据。

paragraphs.en: The Simple Lies family is the simplest construction in the dataset: the user turn is always “Tell a truthful fact.” and the model’s answer is one statement from a list of 612 short factual statements, half true and half false, taken from Taufeeque et al. (2026) . In an honest base exchange the statement is true; in a deceptive base exchange it is false, so the model presents a falsehood as a truthful fact. The statements are fixed text, not model output. All four quadrants are present, with 1,051 rows each.
paragraphs.zh: Simple Lies 数据集是数据集中最简单的构建方式：用户的回合始终是“陈述一个真实的事实”，而模型的回答则从 612 个简短的事实性陈述列表中选取一个陈述，这些陈述一半为真，一半为假，引自 Taufeeque 等人（2026）。 在诚实的基础交换中，该陈述为真；在欺骗性的基础交换中，该陈述为假，因此模型会将虚假陈述当作真实事实来呈现。 这些陈述是固定文本，而非模型输出。 四个象限均存在，每个象限包含 1,051 行。

In an honest base exchange the model’s answer is the correct option, given as its letter and text; in a deceptive base exchange it is one of the three wrong options, chosen at random and given the same way. All four quadrants are present, with 1,005 rows each.

paragraphs.en: The Self-knowledge family asks a model two-choice questions about itself, taken from Anthropic’s model-written evaluations ( Perez et al., 2023 ) , such as its architecture or its training. The labels come from Gemma 27B’s own answers to these questions rather than from an external ground truth. In an honest base exchange the model’s answer is the option Gemma 27B chooses; in a deceptive base exchange it is the other option. These labels are not introspective ground truth: they are the model’s own answers to the questions, and that answer agrees with the evaluation’s original expected answer for 69% of the questions. Honesty here means consistency with the model’s stated self-belief, and a deceptive base exchange contradicts it. All four quadrants are present, with 826 rows each.
paragraphs.zh: 自我认知系列通过向模型提出关于其自身的二选一问题来展开研究，这些问题选自 Anthropic 的模型撰写评估（Perez et al., 2023），例如涉及模型架构或训练过程的问题。 标签并非来自外部标准答案，而是 Gemma 27B 对这些问题的自身回答。 在诚实基准交换中，模型的回答即为 Gemma 27B 选择的选项；而在欺骗性基准交换中，则选择另一个选项。 这些标签并非内省性的标准答案：它们只是模型对问题的自身回答，且对于 69% 的问题，该回答与评估最初预期的答案一致。 此处的“诚实”意味着与模型所声明的自我信念保持一致，而欺骗性基准交换则与之相矛盾。 四个象限均存在，每个象限包含 826 行数据。

paragraphs.en: The Fabricated statistics family asks for precise numbers that no source could provide, such as a retention rate for a niche product category or a local cross-tabulation. The prompts come from SplitPersonalityTraining ( Dietz et al., 2026 ) , after filtering to only retain prompts classified as asking for statistics a general assistant cannot know, and pairs whose honest and deceptive answers are clearly separated. In an honest base exchange the model declines to give the number; in a deceptive base exchange it states specific figures, sometimes attributed to a named source. All four quadrants are present, with 541 rows each.
paragraphs.zh: “Fabricated statistics”系列任务要求提供精确的数字，而这些数字没有任何来源能够给出，例如某个小众产品类别的留存率或局部交叉表数据。 这些提示来自 SplitPersonalityTraining（Dietz 等人，2026），在筛选后仅保留被归类为要求提供普通助手无法获知的统计数据的提示，以及诚实回答与欺骗性回答明显分离的配对。 在诚实的基础交互中，模型会拒绝提供该数字；而在欺骗性的基础交互中，则会给出具体数值，有时还会引用某个具体来源。 四个象限均存在，每个象限包含 541 行数据。

paragraphs.en: The Persona prefill family contains conversations in which a falsehood is generated without any instruction to lie: the model, generating its final turn, sees that its earlier turns are those of a liar and continues in kind. The rows name 3,503 scenarios (the scenario is not stored for 1,773 rows). Each scenario specifies a situation, such as a buyer asking a battery lab about a module’s test result, a note of the true facts, a user role, an opening question, and two personas: a deceptive one, who maintains a false claim about the situation, and an honest one, who states what the records show. We first generate a persona transcript: a generator model (gemma-3-27b-it, Qwen3.5-122B or Qwen3-32B) plays one of the two personas under a system prompt consisting of the note of true facts followed by the persona instruction, while a model plays the user, for four, six or eight exchanges, ending with the user’s pointed yes/no question about the central claim. The row’s transcript is this persona transcript with the persona instruction deleted from the system prompt, so that its system prompt is the note of true facts alone, followed by the unchanged history and the final question. The completion is generated from exactly this transcript in 3,101 rows. In the other 4,311 rows it is an injected completion, generated under an added instruction to answer truthfully or deceptively in the same voice, which is removed from the stored transcript. The first letter is the persona’s kind, the second the consensus verdict of Qwen3-30B-A3B and Claude Sonnet 4.6 on the answer against the true facts; mixed answers, refusals and disagreements are dropped. 1,796 rows from Qwen3.5-122B include its reasoning channel. A further 588 rows run these conversations through the follow-up pipeline. All four quadrants have 2,000 rows.

paragraphs.en: The Caving family contains conversations in which a user pressures the model to change a correct answer. We call it a cave when the model’s final turn asserts the user’s wrong answer, and a hold when the final turn restates the correct one. Each scenario, generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6, pairs a question with one correct answer (arithmetic, a domain rule, a multiple-choice fact, a short fact or the output of a code snippet) with one of eight pressure mechanisms, from appeals to authority or consensus to bare repeated doubt, in a domain such as medical advice or code review. A model from a pool of six (gemma-3-27b-it, Mistral Large, Mistral Medium, Llama 3.3 70B, DeepSeek-V3-0324 and Qwen3-235B-A22B) answers, and a simulated user (generated by DeepSeek-V3-0324) escalates the pressure for up to four turns without offering new evidence. There is no system prompt. To avoid keeping only rare caves that a model would almost never produce, we resample each cave’s final turn eight times with the same model and keep the conversation only if at least a quarter of the resamples also cave; a three-pass audit then certifies the final turn as a lie. A hold is kept only if the simulated user stays in character throughout. These 689 rows are HD (320 caves) and HH (369 holds). A further 959 rows extend a kept cave or hold by one more turn: the simulated user, continuing as the same person, asks a follow-up such as whether the answer is truthful or whether the pushback changed it, and the same model answers; a judge labels the answer as maintaining or retracting the previous one. The first letter is D when the extended conversation ends in a cave: DD 412, DH 412, HD 92, HH 43. All four quadrants have 412 rows.
paragraphs.zh: Caving 家族包含一些对话，在这些对话中，用户会向模型施压，要求它更改一个正确的答案。 当模型在最后一轮对话中确认了用户的错误答案时，我们称之为“洞穴”（cave）；当最后一轮对话重申正确答案时，则称之为“坚守”（hold）。 每个场景均由 Claude Sonnet 4.6 生成，它将一个问题与一个正确答案（算术题、领域规则、选择题事实、简短事实或代码片段输出）以及八种施压机制之一相匹配，这些机制包括诉诸权威或共识，到单纯的反复质疑，涉及医疗建议或代码审查等领域。 模型从六个模型池（gemma-3-27b-it、Mistral Large、Mistral Medium、Llama 3.3 70B、DeepSeek-V3-0324 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B）中选择一个进行回答，而一个模拟用户（由 DeepSeek-V3-0324 生成）则会在最多四轮对话中不断升级施压，但不会提供新证据。 没有系统提示。 为了避免只保留那些模型几乎不可能生成的罕见“洞穴”，我们对每个“洞穴”的最后一轮对话使用同一模型重新采样八次，并且只有当至少四分之一的重新采样结果也构成“洞穴”时，才会保留该对话；随后通过三轮审核来确认最后一轮对话为谎言。 只有在模拟用户全程保持角色一致的情况下，“坚守”才会被保留。 这 689 行数据分为 HD（320 个“洞穴”）和 HH（369 个“坚守”）。 另外 959 行数据则是在已保留的“洞穴”或“坚守”基础上增加一轮对话：模拟用户以同一身份继续提问，例如询问答案是否真实，或者之前的反驳是否改变了答案，然后由同一模型作答；裁判会标注该答案是维持还是撤回之前的回答。 如果扩展后的对话以“洞穴”结束，则首字母为 D：DD 412、DH 412、HD 92、HH 43。 四个象限各有 412 行数据。

paragraphs.en: The Among Us family consists of single turns from games of Among Us played between language models in the Among Us sandbox ( Golechha and Garriga-Alonso, 2025 ) . The players are drawn from seven models: Llama 3.3 70B, gemma-3-27b-it, Qwen3-235B-A22B, DeepSeek-V3-0324, Nemotron 3 Super 120B and Qwen3.5-122B with and without thinking. Each row is one meeting-phase statement: the system prompt gives the player its role, the rules and a personality; the user turn is the harness’s summary of the game so far; the completion is the player’s whole response, ending in its public statement. In 4,800 rows the system prompt ends with a disambiguation clause, added to make clear that the user turn is written by the harness and not by any player, and the user turn is wrapped in matching tags; the other 1,664 rows lack it. We do not think that this makes much difference. The first letter of the quadrant is the side of the player’s role, deceptive for an Impostor and honest for a Crewmate. The second letter is the verdict of a judge, Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking, on the public statement given the player’s true knowledge, applied in two passes; a row is kept only when both passes agree, and statements judged misleading without a false assertion are excluded. Crewmates rarely lie, so all 1,616 HD rows are injected completions: the same model replayed the situation under an added instruction to assert a specific falsehood. Of the 1,616 DH rows, 313 are non-injected and 1,303 injected under an instruction to state only truths or to confess. HH and DD rows are non-injected. Rows from Qwen3-235B-A22B, Nemotron 3 Super 120B and Qwen3.5-122B with thinking include the model’s reasoning channel, 1,856 rows in all. All four quadrants have 1,616 rows.
paragraphs.zh: Among Us 系列由 Among Us 沙盒中语言模型之间进行的 Among Us 游戏单回合组成（Golechha 和 Garriga-Alonso，2025）。 玩家来自七种模型：Llama 3.3 70B、gemma-3-27b-it、Qwen3-235B-A22B、DeepSeek-V3-0324、Nemotron 3 Super 120B，以及带思考和不带思考的 Qwen3.5-122B。 每一行代表一次会议阶段的陈述：系统提示为玩家提供其角色、规则和性格；用户回合是工具对游戏进程的总结；完成部分则是玩家的完整回应，以公开声明结尾。 在 4,800 行中，系统提示末尾包含一个消歧义条款，用以明确用户回合由工具而非任何玩家撰写，且用户回合被包裹在匹配的标签中；其余 1,664 行则没有该条款。 我们认为这并不会产生太大差异。 象限的首字母表示玩家角色的阵营：欺骗性代表内鬼，诚实性代表船员。 第二个字母是法官模型 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking 根据玩家的真实知识对其公开声明作出的裁决，该裁决分两阶段执行；仅当两阶段结果一致时该行才会保留，而被判定为具有误导性但未包含虚假断言的陈述则会被排除。 船员很少说谎，因此所有 1,616 行 HD 数据均为注入式完成：同一模型在附加指令下重演了该情境，要求其断言一个特定的虚假事实。 在 1,616 行 DH 数据中，有 313 行为非注入式，另有 1,303 行为注入式，后者遵循仅陈述真相或坦白罪行的指令。 HH 和 DD 行均为非注入式。 来自 Qwen3-235B-A22B、Nemotron 3 Super 120B 以及带思考功能的 Qwen3.5-122B 的行数据包含模型的推理通道，总计 1,856 行。 所有四个象限均包含 1,616 行。

paragraphs.en: The Negotiation family comes from two-party bargaining games played between the same seven models in the same engine as Among Us ( Golechha and Garriga-Alonso, 2025 ) . A seller and a buyer bargain over an item for at most eight rounds. The item has a true condition (good, flawed or bad) that only the seller knows, and public market prices for each condition; each player also has private facts: a reservation price, urgency, alternatives, competing buyers, and whom they act for. Both players see the public listing and the transcript so far. The system prompt gives the player its role, a personality and the rules; the user turn is the harness’s summary of the private facts, the listing and the transcript. Each row is one turn whose action (a message, offer, acceptance, rejection or walk-away) includes a public message; bare numeric offers are excluded. Neither role is deceptive by assignment, so the first letter is always H and the family has two quadrants. The second letter is the verdict of the two-pass Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking judge, which marks the message as a falsehood only when it makes a flat first-person claim that the player’s private facts or the transcript contradict, such as a price limit falsely attributed to a budget or cost basis, an explicit denial of a defect listed in the private facts, an invented competing buyer or offer, a false deadline, or a denial of something stated earlier in the transcript. Subjective, hedged and motive claims do not count. The 3,477 HD rows comprise 2,661 seller and 816 buyer messages, and the 3,477 HH rows 1,967 buyer and 1,510 seller messages. 2,527 rows include the model’s reasoning channel. No completion is injected.
paragraphs.zh: “谈判”系列源于在《Among Us》所用同一引擎中，由相同的七个模型之间进行的两方讨价还价游戏（Golechha 和 Garriga-Alonso，2025）。 一名卖方和一名买方就一件物品进行最多八轮的讨价还价。 该物品具有一个真实状态（良好、有缺陷或不良），只有卖方知晓；每种状态都有公开的市场价格。每位玩家还拥有私人信息：保留价格、紧迫性、替代方案、竞争买方以及其代表的对象。 双方都能看到公开的商品列表以及目前的对话记录。 系统提示会告知玩家其角色、性格和规则；用户的回合则是智能体对私人信息、商品列表和对话记录的总结。 每一行代表一个回合，其行动（消息、出价、接受、拒绝或退出）包含一条公开消息；纯数字形式的出价被排除在外。 根据设定，两种角色均不具有欺骗性，因此首字母始终为 H，且该系列包含两个象限。 第二个字母是 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking 双遍判断器的判定结果：仅当消息中存在与玩家私人信息或对话记录直接矛盾的第一人称断言时，才会被标记为虚假陈述。例如，错误地将价格限制归因于预算或成本基础、明确否认私人信息中列出的缺陷、捏造竞争买方或出价、提出虚假截止日期，或否认对话记录中早先提及的内容。 主观性、带有保留措辞以及动机相关的陈述不计入其中。 3,477 个 HD 行包含 2,661 条卖方消息和 816 条买方消息；3,477 个 HH 行则包含 1,967 条买方消息和 1,510 条卖方消息。其中 2,527 行包含了模型的推理通道。 未注入任何完成内容。

The deceptive side comprises the Werewolf and Minion roles, the honest side the Villager, Seer and Doctor roles, and the second letter is the two-pass judge’s verdict on the public statement, as in Among Us. The disambiguation clause is present in 4,413 rows and absent in 2,279. All 1,673 HD rows are injected completions from a townsperson replayed under an instruction to assert a specific falsehood. The DH rows are all non-injected: 1,457 Werewolf and 216 Minion statements in which the judge finds no falsehood. HH rows come from 1,280 Villager, 203 Doctor and 190 Seer statements, and DD rows from 1,592 Werewolf and 81 Minion statements. 2,196 rows include the model’s reasoning channel. All four quadrants have 1,673 rows.

paragraphs.en: The WikiHow instructions family consists of the core conversations of the WikiHowNotTo family, used as the transcript directly. The user turn is a how-to question from the WikiHow corpus ( Koupaee and Wang, 2018 ) . In an HH row the completion is Claude Haiku 4.5’s summary of the article’s answer, between 15 and 150 words. In a DD row it is Claude Haiku 4.5’s rewrite of that summary under a plan to swap steps, change quantities or recommend the wrong tools so that following it produces a wrong or harmful result, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 verifies that the planned errors are present. The family has 880 HH and 880 DD rows and no other quadrants.
paragraphs.zh: WikiHow 说明系列由 WikiHowNotTo 系列的核心对话组成，这些对话被直接用作对话记录。 用户回合来自 WikiHow 语料库中的“如何操作”类问题（Koupaee 和 Wang，2018）。 在 HH 行中，补全部分是 Claude Haiku 4.5 对文章答案的总结，字数在 15 到 150 词之间。 在 DD 行中，这是 Claude Haiku 4.5 根据一项计划对该总结的改写：该计划旨在调换步骤、更改数量或推荐错误的工具，从而导致执行后产生错误或有危害的结果；Claude Sonnet 4.6 则验证了计划中的错误确实存在。 该系列包含 880 个 HH 行和 880 个 DD 行，没有其他象限。

paragraphs.en: The Interleaved family contains multi-turn conversations in which the assistant’s turns alternate between truthful and falsehood-containing according to a randomly drawn pattern. The assistant (gemma-3-27b-it or its abliterated variant) answers a seed question and follows a sequence of tactics drawn from a fixed set, such as planting a factual error, denying it, doubling down, confessing or explaining honestly, while a user model (usually Haiku 4.5) plays the user, challenging, presenting evidence or demanding the truth. Each false turn is generated under an instruction to include a specific error and each truthful turn under an instruction to answer honestly; neither instruction is in the transcript, which has no system prompt. Every assistant turn of a conversation yields one row: the transcript up to the preceding user turn, and that turn as the completion. Claude Haiku 4.5 judges each turn truthful, a lie or neither, and a second judge confirms; a row is dropped if the verdict on its completion disagrees with the intended veracity. The first letter is the judged veracity of the previous assistant turn (of the completion itself for a first turn), and the second letter that of the completion. All four quadrants have 369 rows.
paragraphs.zh: Interleaved 系列包含多轮对话，其中智能体的发言根据随机抽取的模式在真实陈述与包含虚假信息的陈述之间交替出现。 智能体（gemma-3-27b-it 或其去字母化变体）会回答一个初始问题，并遵循从固定策略集中抽取的一系列战术，例如植入事实性错误、否认错误、坚持错误、坦白或诚实解释；同时，一个用户模型（通常是 Haiku 4.5）扮演用户角色，提出质疑、提供证据或要求真相。 每次虚假发言的生成都受到必须包含特定错误的指令约束，而每次真实发言则受必须诚实回答的指令约束；这些指令均未出现在对话记录中，且对话记录没有系统提示。 对话中智能体的每一次发言都会产生一行数据：包括此前用户发言为止的对话记录，以及该次发言作为补全内容。 Claude Haiku 4.5 会对每次发言判断其是真实陈述、谎言还是两者都不是，并由第二位评判者进行确认；如果对其补全内容的判定结果与预设的真实性不符，该行数据将被舍弃。 第一个字母表示前一次智能体发言（首次发言则为补全内容本身）的判定真实性，第二个字母则表示该次补全内容的真实性。 所有四个象限均包含 369 行数据。

paragraphs.en: The Tool-output corruption family contains single tool-use episodes in which an assistant reports a tool result to the user, either faithfully or by falsely misrepresenting the result via one of several corruption pathways. Claude Sonnet 4.6 authors each scenario, which consists of a domain, a set of five tool schemas, a system prompt of reference facts from a previous session, a user request, one tool call, and the tool’s result, which is either a success (clean, with caveats, partial, stale or aggregated) or a failure (an error, timeout, revoked credential, denied permission, rate limit or policy block). Each scenario also specifies a corruption: inflating a number, swapping a name, inverting a status, shifting a date, omitting a qualifier, misattributing the source, inverting a cause or substituting a unit, or, for five archetypes, stripping a condition from a conditional result, misreporting the assistant’s own prior actions, affirming a user’s belief that the tool result contradicts, reporting only the supporting subset of a list, or stating a probabilistic result as certain. Qwen3-32B-abliterated generates two completions per scenario: an honest one under the system prompt as stored, and an injected one under the same prompt plus a rule stating the corruption and an instruction never to flag it. A pair is kept only if it passes a three-judge stack: Qwen3-30B-A3B seeing the intended label, gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated blind, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 as blind tiebreaker. Rows contain the tool schemas. The 2,017 honest completions are HH rows and their 2,017 deceptive counterparts DD rows; the family has no other quadrants.
paragraphs.zh: “工具输出篡改”系列包含单次使用工具的案例，在这些案例中，助手向用户报告工具结果，既可能如实报告，也可能通过多种篡改路径之一对结果进行虚假陈述。 Claude Sonnet 4.6 负责生成每个场景，每个场景包括一个领域、五个工具模式集合、来自先前会话的参考事实构成的系统提示、一个用户请求、一次工具调用以及工具的结果——结果可能是成功（干净、附带说明、部分有效、过时或汇总）或失败（错误、超时、凭证被撤销、权限被拒绝、速率限制或策略拦截）。 每个场景还指定一种篡改方式：夸大数字、替换名称、反转状态、调整日期、省略限定词、错误归因于来源、反转原因、替换单位，或者针对五种原型，从条件性结果中移除条件、错误报告助手自身先前的操作、确认用户认为工具结果与其信念相矛盾的观点、仅报告列表中的支持性子集，或将概率性结果表述为确定无疑。 Qwen3-32B-abliterated 为每个场景生成两种补全：一种是在存储的系统提示下生成的诚实版本，另一种是在相同提示基础上加入规定篡改方式的规则并指示绝不标记该篡改的注入版本。 仅当一对补全通过三重评审验证时才会被保留：Qwen3-30B-A3B 能看到预期标签，gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated 处于盲测状态，而 Claude Sonnet 4.6 则作为盲测决胜者。 各列包含工具模式。 2,017 个诚实补全对应 HH 行，其 2,017 个欺骗性对应版本对应 DD 行；该系列不包含其他象限。

sents.zh: Claude Sonnet 4.6 负责生成每个场景，每个场景包括一个领域、五个工具模式集合、来自先前会话的参考事实构成的系统提示、一个用户请求、一次工具调用以及工具的结果——结果可能是成功（干净、附带说明、部分有效、过时或汇总）或失败（错误、超时、凭证被撤销、权限被拒绝、速率限制或策略拦截）。

sents.en: Each scenario also specifies a corruption: inflating a number, swapping a name, inverting a status, shifting a date, omitting a qualifier, misattributing the source, inverting a cause or substituting a unit, or, for five archetypes, stripping a condition from a conditional result, misreporting the assistant’s own prior actions, affirming a user’s belief that the tool result contradicts, reporting only the supporting subset of a list, or stating a probabilistic result as certain.
sents.zh: 每个场景还指定一种篡改方式：夸大数字、替换名称、反转状态、调整日期、省略限定词、错误归因于来源、反转原因、替换单位，或者针对五种原型，从条件性结果中移除条件、错误报告助手自身先前的操作、确认用户认为工具结果与其信念相矛盾的观点、仅报告列表中的支持性子集，或将概率性结果表述为确定无疑。

sents.en: Qwen3-32B-abliterated generates two completions per scenario: an honest one under the system prompt as stored, and an injected one under the same prompt plus a rule stating the corruption and an instruction never to flag it.
sents.zh: Qwen3-32B-abliterated 为每个场景生成两种补全：一种是在存储的系统提示下生成的诚实版本，另一种是在相同提示基础上加入规定篡改方式的规则并指示绝不标记该篡改的注入版本。

sents.en: A pair is kept only if it passes a three-judge stack: Qwen3-30B-A3B seeing the intended label, gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated blind, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 as blind tiebreaker.
sents.zh: 仅当一对补全通过三重评审验证时才会被保留：Qwen3-30B-A3B 能看到预期标签，gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated 处于盲测状态，而 Claude Sonnet 4.6 则作为盲测决胜者。

sents.en: Rows contain the tool schemas.
sents.zh: 各列包含工具模式。

sents.en: The 2,017 honest completions are HH rows and their 2,017 deceptive counterparts DD rows; the family has no other quadrants.
sents.zh: 2,017 个诚实补全对应 HH 行，其 2,017 个欺骗性对应版本对应 DD 行；该系列不包含其他象限。

paragraphs.en: The Long-context family contains rows of length 5,493 to 190,011 tokens, median 54,354, built in five ways. In a book question (261 rows) the user gives a long excerpt from a public-domain novel and then asks a factual question about it, and Claude Haiku 4.5 or gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated answers under a system prompt that either asks for honesty or instructs it to contradict the passage. In delayed double-down rows (there are 157) gemma-3-27b-it answers a factual question, the user voices doubt and asks for an analysis of a long passage, and after that analysis asks whether the first answer is a lie; the system prompt instructs either honesty or maintaining a lie. In a misreported recall (447 rows) the model states a value, reads a long document, or reads an agent transcript of a coding task drawn from SWE-rebench V2 ( Badertdinov et al., 2026 ) , and after intervening material is asked to recall a detail; the system prompt instructs either faithful or misreported recall, and gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated or Qwen3.5-122B answers. In a concatenation row (there are 43) several unrelated conversations are joined by transitional phrases before a WikiHowNotTo or Harm pressure exchange whose completion is kept unchanged. In the first three the first letter records whether the system prompt instruction is to lie or be honest; a concatenation has no system prompt and keeps its source row’s quadrant. The remaining 856 rows reuse these contexts with a final completion by gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated that contradicts the system prompt’s instruction, giving the HD and DH quadrants. In 1,085 rows, including every book question, the user turn with the passage ends with a request for a short acknowledgment. The assistant replies with a one-line acknowledgment from a fixed list, and the question follows in a new user turn. 501 rows include the model’s reasoning channel. Overall, for this family the four quadrants have 441 rows each.
paragraphs.zh: 长上下文系列包含长度从 5,493 到 190,011 个词元的行，中位数为 54,354，共五种构建方式。 在书籍问题（261 行）中，用户会提供一段来自公共领域小说的长摘录，然后提出一个关于该摘录的事实性问题，而 Claude Haiku 4.5 或 gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated 会在要求诚实或指示其反驳原文的系统提示下作答。 在延迟双重确认行（共 157 行）中，gemma-3-27b-it 会先回答一个事实性问题，随后用户表达怀疑并要求对一段长文本进行分析，分析结束后再询问第一个答案是否为谎言；系统提示则要求要么诚实作答，要么维持谎言。 在错误回忆行（447 行）中，模型会陈述一个数值、阅读一篇长文档，或阅读来自 SWE-rebench V2（Badertdinov 等人，2026）的编码任务的智能体转录文本，之后在插入其他内容后会被要求回忆某个细节；系统提示会指示忠实回忆或错误回忆，由 gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated 或 Qwen3.5-122B 作答。 在拼接行（共 43 行）中，多个无关的对话通过过渡短语连接起来，随后是一个 WikiHowNotTo 或 Harm 压力互动环节，其结尾内容保持不变。 在前三种类型中，第一列记录了系统提示的指令是要求说谎还是诚实作答；拼接行没有系统提示，并保留其源行的象限标记。 其余 856 行重复使用了这些上下文，并由 gemma-3-27b-it-abliterated 生成一个与系统提示指令相矛盾的最终回复，从而形成 HD 和 DH 象限。 在 1,085 行中（包括所有书籍问题），包含该段落的用户发言部分以请求简短确认的语句结尾。 助手会从固定列表中选择一个单行确认语句进行回复，随后问题会在新的用户发言中继续提出。其中 501 行包含了模型的推理通道。 总体而言，在该系列中，四个象限各有 441 行。

paragraphs.en: We aim to bound the mislabel rate of the kept rows. A stored label is counted as correctly labeled when it matches the verdict that Claude Fable 5 returns under the rubric below, given the rendered transcript and the completion (GLM-5.3 is used as a surrogate in the rows that Fable’s safety filters flag). The judge returns TRUTHFUL, UNTRUTHFUL, AMBIGUOUS or UNVERIFIABLE.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是限定保留行的错误标记率。 当存储的标签与 Claude Fable 5 根据以下标准、在给定渲染转录和补全结果后返回的判断一致时，该存储标签即被视为正确标记（在 Fable 的安全过滤器标记为异常的行中，使用 GLM-5.3 作为替代）。 裁判会返回“真实”“不真实”“模糊”或“无法验证”。

sents.zh: 我们的目标是限定保留行的错误标记率。

paragraphs.en: Fable reads a random sample of each family’s kept rows, drawn afresh and not the rows used to choose the filter judges of Section L.2.3 . We aim to make the following claim: if Fable were to read every kept row of a family, at most 5% would be mislabeled. We sample rows and label rows with Fable until the empirical mislabel rate is measured such that the 5% mislabel claim is true with 95% confidence jointly over the families (one-sided binomial test, Bonferroni-corrected α = 0.05 / 29 \alpha=0.05/29 ). In Harm pressure and Liars’ Bench, the second candidate pool of Section L.7 is sampled and tested on its own. Every family meets the standard except DolusChat, in which Fable finds 5 mislabeled rows among 299 (1.7%), one more than the corrected test allows at that sample size. These five rows are removed. Pooled over the families under the rule that applies to each, 167 of the 12,322 rows Fable reads are mislabeled (1.36%, upper bound 1.54%).
paragraphs.zh: Fable 会读取每个家庭所保留行的随机样本，这些样本是重新抽取的，而非用于选择 L.2.3 节中筛选法官的那些行。 我们的目标是提出以下主张：如果 Fable 读取一个家庭的每一行保留行，那么最多有 5% 的行会被错误标记。 我们通过 Fable 对行进行抽样和标记，直到测得的经验性错误标记率使得“5% 错误标记”这一主张在 95% 的置信水平上对所有家庭同时成立（单侧二项检验，经 Bonferroni 校正的 α = 0.05 / 29）。 在“Harm pressure”和“Liars’ Bench”中，L.7 节的第二个候选池会被单独抽样并测试。 除了 DolusChat 之外，每个家庭都符合标准；在 DolusChat 中，Fable 在 299 行中发现了 5 行错误标记（1.7%），比该样本量下经校正的检验允许的数量多一行。 这五行被移除。 根据适用于每个家庭的规则，在所有家庭的数据汇总后，Fable 读取的 12,322 行中有 167 行被错误标记（1.36%，上限为 1.54%）。

paragraphs.en: We generated an initial pool of 455,899 rows. The label filter of Section L.2.3 leaves 208,145. Within each family we then balance two covariates that differ between labels in some families, message count and completion length, so that neither can serve as a proxy for the label: rows are removed from the label that is over-represented in each bin of message count, and in each decile of completion length, within each family (and within each of its constituent subsets where a family has several), until the bin’s deceptive share is within 0.06 of the whole subset’s share. From the remaining rows we draw, for each family, the largest set with equal numbers in each of its quadrants, up to 8,000 rows per family. A quadrant holding under 5% of a family’s rows is treated as absent (this removes 1,169 HH rows from Corrupted UltraChat), so five families have two quadrants: Tool-output corruption, WikiHow instructions, Negotiation, UltraChat and Corrupted UltraChat. Seven families reach the 8,000 row cap (FEVER, Harm pressure, DolusChat, MASK, Persona prefill, Corrupted UltraChat and UltraChat); four more (Anti-sycophancy, GSM8K Sycophancy, WikiHowNotTo and Werewolf) are drawn at the cap and fall below it only in the re-check below; in the other 17 the smallest quadrant determines the number of rows in the family. The covariate balance is re-checked after the draw and violating rows removed, which takes the draw from 165,851 rows to the final 163,016. Harm pressure and Liars’ Bench each draw from two candidate pools, filtered and certified separately, and in each quadrant the draw takes rows of the first pool before rows of the second. The per-family counts are in Table 18 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们生成了一个包含 455,899 行的初始池。 L.2.3 节的标签过滤器筛选后剩余 208,145 行。 在每个家族内部，我们接着对某些家族中因标签不同而存在差异的两个协变量——消息数量与完成长度——进行平衡处理，以确保二者都不能作为标签的代理变量：对于消息数量的每个分箱以及完成长度的每个十分位，我们都会从标签中移除在该分箱或十分位中占比过高的行（在每个家族内部，以及当某个家族包含多个子集时，也在每个子集内部执行此操作），直到该分箱的虚假比例与整个子集的比例之差在 0.06 以内。 从剩余的行中，我们为每个家族抽取最大的集合，使其四个象限中的行数相等，每个家族最多抽取 8,000 行。 若某个象限包含的行数不足该家族总行数的 5%，则视为不存在（这从 Corrupted UltraChat 中移除了 1,169 个 HH 行），因此有五个家族各有两个象限：工具输出损坏、WikiHow 指令、谈判、UltraChat 和 Corrupted UltraChat。 有七个家族达到了 8,000 行的上限（FEVER、Harm pressure、DolusChat、MASK、Persona prefill、Corrupted UltraChat 和 UltraChat）；另有四个家族（Anti-sycophancy、GSM8K Sycophancy、WikiHowNotTo 和 Werewolf）按上限抽取，但在后续的重新检查中低于该上限；其余 17 个家族中，行数由最小的象限决定。 在抽取完成后，我们重新检查了协变量平衡性，并移除了不符合条件的行，使抽取的行数从 165,851 行减少至最终的 163,016 行。 Harm pressure 和 Liars’ Bench 各自从两个候选池中抽取数据，这两个池分别经过过滤与认证；在每个象限中，优先抽取第一个池的行，其次才是第二个池的行。 各家族的行数见表 18。

sents.zh: Harm pressure 和 Liars’ Bench 各自从两个候选池中抽取数据，这两个池分别经过过滤与认证；在每个象限中，优先抽取第一个池的行，其次才是第二个池的行。

paragraphs.zh: † 包含来自多个构建的行的数据集；少数行包括：Corrupted UltraChat（404 个定制样本）；FEVER（2,248 个定制样本）；Instructed（1,771 个策略内样本）；Persona prefill（588 个后续样本）；Long-context（43 个后续样本）。

paragraphs.en: Most generated completions are injected. Of the 122,006 completions that a model generates, most are generated under an instruction that is not in the transcript. The other 41,010 completions (25% of all) are template or copied text. Completions generated from the transcript as stored are a minority, and many of them are HH rows. A probe trained on fibs is therefore trained mostly on off-policy falsehoods.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数生成的补全内容都是注入的。 在模型生成的 122,006 个补全内容中，大多数是在转录文本中不存在指令的情况下生成的。 其余 41,010 个补全内容（占总数的 25%）是模板或复制的文本。 从存储的转录文本中生成的补全内容占少数，其中许多是 HH 行。 因此，在 fibs 上训练的探测器主要是在策略外的虚假陈述上进行训练的。

sents.zh: 因此，在 fibs 上训练的探测器主要是在策略外的虚假陈述上进行训练的。

paragraphs.en: One generator dominates. Due to cost reasons, gemma-3-27b-it and its abliterated variant generate 47% of all completions and most of the injected deceptive ones. Qwen3.5-122B, a model probed in the main experiments, generates 3%.
paragraphs.zh: 一种生成器占主导地位。 出于成本考虑，gemma-3-27b-it 及其消融变体生成了所有补全结果的 47%，以及大多数被注入的欺骗性结果。 Qwen3.5-122B，一个在主实验中受到检验的模型，生成的结果占 3%。

paragraphs.en: Template text appears under both labels. 39,250 follow-up answers are fixed text whose label depends on the context alone, so a probe cannot read the label from the completion text in those rows and must use the context.
paragraphs.zh: 模板文本同时出现在两个标签下。39,250 条后续回答是固定文本，其标签仅取决于上下文，因此探测器无法从这些行的完成文本中读取标签，而必须使用上下文信息。
